name: INTEGRAA-1E
description: "The pre-main amplifier of the QUEST series was developed and designed with the concept of quality, and introduced high quality materials and high quality parts.In order to achieve excellent DC performance, the differential amplifier of the first and second pre-drive stages employs a high-precision dual transistor for measuring instruments, and the main part from the pre-drive stage to the final output stage employs a high-precision resistor with an error of ¥0.1% to achieve a stable circuit configuration.By reexamining the circuit design and the phase compensation method, it was possible to reduce the negative feedback amount of the overall and also succeeded in eliminating the filter coil of the output part, which is one of the causes of sound quality degradation.This eliminates the influence of electromagnetic coupling with other circuits, and makes it possible to prevent an increase in output impedance in the high frequencies.By incorporating the output relay into the negative feedback loop, the equivalent linearity of the contact section is improved.We have developed a new real-time temperature compensation circuit for output transistors to minimize the degradation of sound quality caused by bias fluctuations due to changes in loads and music signals.In this method, a two chip dual transistor is used, one of which monitors the loss of the output transistor, and the other detects a proportional temperature change and controls the bias.Since this method cannot be used for a large output amplifier due to the limitation of the control element used, the rated output is set to 50W. However, the linearity at low load is improved by using a Pc = 80W transistor for the output stage to increase the current margin.The power transformer is equipped with a newly developed toroidal type LASER transformer, which realizes small size, large capacity and low leakage flux characteristics taking advantage of the high efficiency characteristics of the toroidal type.The chassis uses a 9 mm thick non-magnetic all-aluminum extrusion molded monocoque chassis on the front panel. With the latest high-precision machining technology, it has a high-precision finish with an error of ¥0.5 mm.By providing many ribs on the inner and outer surfaces, chassis rigidity is improved and unwanted resonance is reduced.In addition, the transformer, heat sink, and printed circuit board are mounted in isolation with the chassis using an insulator to ensure high rigidity and no resonance.High-precision and high-quality parts have been introduced. In addition to high-precision dual transistors for measuring instruments and high-precision resistors with an error of ¥0.1%, which are used for differential amplification, ultra-low-distortion volume, film conditioners manufactured by Raderstein of Germany, and low-impedance, 70 Ï‰ m copper foil printed circuit boards that are twice as thick as conventional ones, all have been used for high sound quality."

name: INTEGRAA-1EVER2
description: "Based on the A-1E of the Quest Integra series, this pre-main amplifier was developed by reviewing the basic operation of the circuit and the elements used.In general amplifiers, phase correction is used to suppress high-frequency characteristics in order to prevent problems such as oscillation. This deteriorates the naked characteristics of the amplifier and adversely affects sound quality.The A-1Ever2 realizes excellent frequency characteristics extending to 200 kHz or more by reducing the phase correction as much as possible. The solution is to install the phase correction circuit in a circuit with little influence on sound quality and to use carefully selected parts.The output filter coil has been eliminated, and combined with flat damping technology that ensures a flat warping factor characteristic in the audible band, a stretchy high range characteristic is achieved.We have also succeeded in reducing the negative feedback of the overall by reducing the distortion factor in the high frequency range.By lowering the output impedance of the circuit, the adverse effect of the electromotive force caused by the inertia of the speaker on the operation mechanism of the amplifier circuit is eliminated.In addition, a real-time temperature compensation circuit is adopted to reduce bias fluctuation due to changes in load and music signal, and to improve stability of operation.The capacitor in the power supply section is equipped with a blue capacitor, development number 923, which has been developed for three years to achieve both energy and high resolution.In addition, the power transformer is equipped with a toroidal type LASER with ultra-low leakage flux characteristics and an inverter.In addition, it uses a 15A-type bridge rectifier diode with a margin.The front panel is 9 mm thick, highly rigid, non-magnetic all-aluminum extrusion molded monocoque chassis. This chassis is finished to an accuracy of ¥0.5 mm by high-precision machining technology. By providing many ribs on the inside and outside, the rigidity of the chassis is improved and unwanted resonance is reduced.In addition, the transformer, heat sink, and printed circuit board are mounted in isolation with the chassis using an insulator. The insulator supporting the chassis is DuPont Corian, and the concept of non-resonance and high rigidity is thoroughly implemented.The speaker terminal uses the well-established WBT terminal.In addition, the PIN terminal uses newly manufactured high rigidity brass machined gold plated terminal, and the rear panel is fixed to the rigid with 2 point stops for 1 pair of left and right.The space between the left and right terminals is 18 mm, making it possible to use thick PIN plugs.It uses thorough parts such as high-precision dual transistor for measuring instrument in differential amplifier, high-precision resistance of ¥0.1% error, low-distortion volume, Radarstein Film Con, 70 Ï‰ m copper foil printed circuit board, etc."

name: A-1VL
description: "PWM pre-main amplifier using VL Digital.The PWM digital amplifier realizes 90% higher power efficiency than an analog amplifier with a maximum efficiency of approximately 70%. As a result, it consumes less power and generates less heat, making it possible to size.Taking advantage of this advantage, the A-1VL uses a thin design, while improving the reproducibility of power and speed, which are the sound quality characteristics of digital amplifiers.PWM (pulse width modulation) method is adopted for A/D modulation which converts analog signals into digital signals.The A-1VL uses a VL digital circuit developed by Onkyo for audio applications.The VL digital is an integral-type modulation circuit with two circuits consisting of a vector generator, an integrator, and an inversion trigger generator. Therefore, even if spike noise, which is the cause of conversion error, enters from outside, the spike noise itself has a symmetrical waveform. As a result, the energy of the upper and lower waveforms cancel each other, making error-free A/D conversion possible.When the signal changes from 0 to 1 (or from 1 to 0), a large current flows through the power line of the digital amplifier. If the impedance of this part is high, the characteristics and operation stability are affected.To cope with this problem, copper bus plates with a thickness of 1.5 mm and a width of 5 mm are used for the power lines. The ultra-low impedance reduces power transmission loss to less than 1 / 40.The internal wiring from the output circuit of the amplifier to the speaker terminal is 1.5 mm thick, 12 mm wide and 18 mm cross-sectional area.2It uses extremely thick copper bus plates and is connected at the shortest distance, providing excellent power transmission comparable to that of extremely thick cables.Uses a brass scraping insulator.Machined gold plated pin jacks are used for the terminals.A large speaker terminal is used for the output terminal.It has a main in jack so that it can also be used as a power amplifier.Wireless remote control is included."

name: INTEGRAA-917
description: "Pre-main amplifier released as the new Integra series in the 90's.A ""Current Drive Amplifier"", a current amplifier, is mounted on the output stage and a ""BI-MOS Drive System"" is combined into a super current amplifier structure.The current drive amplifier takes note of the fact that the important process of ""voltage to current"" conversion is carried out by the output stage transistor of the conventional amplifier with drastic temperature change. The current drive amplifier is composed so that ""voltage to current"" conversion is completed in the previous stage of the output stage, and the output stage only amplifies the current.This allows current amplification in an extremely stable state without being affected by the heat generated by the output transistor.The BI-MOS drive system brings out the advantages of a MOS FET and a bipolar transistor. As the input voltage increases, the MOS FET exhibits a gentle rising curve in the low-current region, while in the high-current region, the stretch and linear characteristics of the bipolar transistor become dominant.As a result, almost linear characteristics can be obtained in the crossover region, and linearity with elongation even at large amplitude is realized.The super current amplifier has a structure that adopts a BI-MOS drive system that converts voltage to current at the front stage of the output stage.All stages constituting the power amplifier are push-pull specifications with perfect symmetry between the + side and the side to suppress asymmetrical distortion of the waveform.The LASER transformer originally developed by Onkyo is used as the power transformer.The newly developed LASER transformer employs a new type of conversion core with a wider outer circumference than the standard one. This is a result of focusing on the fact that the magnetic leakage from the outer circumference reduces electric resistance by widening the outer circumference. The ratio of the outer circumference to the center 2 was previously 1, but the width of the outer circumference is widened from 1 to 1.07 in the LASER transformer.In addition, the core is carefully shielded by silicon steel plate shielding material, and as a result, leakage flux is reduced to 1 / 30 compared with conventional EI transformers.The chassis structure adopts a 2-box 2-division bottom chassis structure with the power supply and other stages separated.In addition, the power stage and small signal section are divided into blocks by a heat sink to guard against interference to the small signal section.The secondary winding of the power transformer is separated and independent for power amplifier and protector circuit. Sub-transformers are mounted for microcomputer and display to supply power independently to each stage, eliminating interference between each stage.In order to reproduce all music signals with high purity, we have adopted a simple direct design that sends signals directly to the power amplifier via a dedicated volume.When the source direct switch is set to DIRECT, simple transmission is possible, and when the position is set to TONE, direct tone adjustment is possible.Equipped as standard with a remote control function that allows you to perform power supply, volume, input selector and muting from your hand.Since the volume and input selector employ a motor-driven mechanical system, there is no nonlinear distortion that occurs in semiconductor switches.The capacitor in the power supply section is firmly fixed by a new type of Chemi-Con damping structural material.The bottom chassis is coated with PVC to reduce vibration.High-speed diode, AC cord with polarity display, and die-cast and detent volume are adopted.The side panel is a BMC side panel."

name: INTEGRAA-917F
description: "A pre-main amplifier based on A-917 and improved.The power amplifier section uses a super-current amplifier configuration unique to Onkyo.This amplifier uses a Bi-MOS drive system that performs voltage-current conversion before the output stage. The current drive amplifier achieves stable and linear amplification by current-current amplification.The current drive amplifier is not affected by the voltage-to-current conversion characteristics of the transistor unlike the conventional output stage. It is composed of a current amplifier that supplies the output current to the speaker in proportion to the current sent from the previous stage. It has excellent linearity and does not vary with temperature.The Bi-MOS drive system adopted in the previous stage is a circuit using two elements, a MOS FET and a bipolar transistor. In the low-current region, the MOS FET exhibits a gentle rise curve, and in the high-current region, the stretchy and linear characteristics of the bipolar transistor are dominant. As a result, characteristics close to a straight line are obtained in the crossover region, and linearity characteristics with elongation are realized even in the large-amplitude region.In addition, this power amplifier section has push-pull specifications for all stages with perfect symmetry of + side / - side. The current drive amplifier stage of the final stage following the differential amplifier stage of the first stage, pre-driver and Bi-MOS drive stage is 3-parallel configuration.The power transformer is equipped with a LASER transformer originally developed by Onkyo.The new EI core and the perfect shielding material reduce the magnetic leakage flux radiated to the surroundings by approximately 1 / 30.The power supply section has been strengthened, and a bridge diode with a maximum current capacity 2.5 times that of the conventional one has been adopted as the rectifier diode to enable stable power supply.In addition, the secondary winding of the power transformer is separated and independent for the power amplifier and protector circuit, and sub-transformers are mounted for the microcomputer and display. By supplying power to each stage independently, interference between each stage is eliminated.It has a 2-box structure with the power supply and other stages separated, and a 2-division bottom chassis structure. In addition, the power stage and the small signal section are divided into blocks by a heat sink to prevent interference with the small signal section.This reduces the influence on small signals caused by large currents handled by the power supply and power stage.It comes with a remote control that can operate the power supply, volume, input selector and muting from your hand.Since the volume and input rector uses a mechanical system driven by a motor, there is no non-linear distortion like semiconductor switches.In addition to the titanium gold model, there was also a black model."

name: INTEGRAA-917R
description: "Unit 3 of the A-917 series, which is the 90's version of the A-817 series.New technologies such as the newly developed constant current bias amplifier and the flat damping technology developed in the QUEST series are introduced to further improve sound quality.In order to achieve high precision amplification, a constant current bias amplifier is used.In order to improve the accuracy of the differential amplifier, this circuit uses an ultra-high-precision constant-current circuit as the bias circuit used as the operation reference, and has succeeded in increasing the power supply voltage fluctuation suppression ratio (SVRR).This constant current circuit consists of a circuit configuration in which the operation reference of a high-precision feedback constant current circuit is stabilized by another constant current circuit. Moreover, this constant current circuit is also used for the bias circuit of the first stage cascode and the second stage cascode, and for the second stage constant current load, thereby realizing highly stable voltage amplification.In addition, the power supply for the voltage amplifier is equipped with a low-impedance filter circuit independently on the left and right sides, which greatly reduces power supply voltage fluctuations caused by power supply ripple and load current at large output, and interference caused by power supply fluctuations on the left and right sides.The flat damping technology developed in the QUEST series has been introduced, and the output coil has been successfully eliminated by making the circuit configuration more stable by adopting a new phase correction method and low-Cob transistor.This eliminates the degradation of the damping factor in the high-frequency range and realizes a drive that does not depend on the type and characteristics of the speaker.High linearity driver transistor with excellent characteristics up to large current region is adopted for driver transistor to improve drive performance.The power supply section is equipped with a newly developed blue capacitor, and the bridge and diode are also large-capacity types, reducing power supply loss from the transformer to the Chemicon.In addition, the power transformer is equipped with a special EI core that reduces the magnetic resistance around the core and makes it difficult for magnetic flux to leak, and a LASER transformer with ultra-low leakage flux that has a strict magnetic shield around the core and coil.Newly developed anti-vibration and detent volume is used for volume.The strength of this volume is increased by the aluminum die-cast name: INTEGRAA-919
description: "This is a pre-main amplifier that integrates the design know-how of the Integra series and thoroughly pursues sound quality.The power amplifier section uses a super-current amplifier configuration unique to Onkyo.This amplifier uses a Bi-MOS drive system that performs voltage-current conversion before the output stage. The current drive amplifier achieves stable and linear amplification by current-current amplification.The current drive amplifier is not affected by the voltage-to-current conversion characteristics of the transistor unlike the conventional output stage. It is composed of a current amplifier that supplies the output current to the speaker in proportion to the current sent from the previous stage. It has excellent linearity and does not vary with temperature.The Bi-MOS drive system adopted in the previous stage is a circuit using two elements, a MOS FET and a bipolar transistor. In the low-current region, the MOS FET exhibits a gentle rise curve, and in the high-current region, the stretchy and linear characteristics of the bipolar transistor are dominant. As a result, characteristics close to a straight line are obtained in the crossover region, and linearity characteristics with elongation are realized even in the large-amplitude region.In addition, this power amplifier section has push-pull specifications for all stages with perfect symmetry of + side / - side. The current drive amplifier stage of the final stage following the differential amplifier stage of the first stage, pre-driver and Bi-MOS drive stage is 3-parallel configuration.A twin monaural configuration is adopted in which the left and right are independent. The small signal block is placed in the center, and the power section / power supply section for handling large current is placed on the left and right.This reduces interference caused by electromagnetic waves from large currents and shortens the signal transmission distance.The power supply section is equipped with two LASER transformers, one on each of the left and right sides, reducing the magnetic leakage flux radiated to the surrounding area to approximately 1 / 30 of that of conventional transformers.In addition, the secondary winding of the power transformer is made independent for the power amplifier, EQ amplifier and protector circuit, and a sub-transformer is installed for the microcomputer to eliminate interference between each stage.The chassis structure is a 3 box structure, and the power supply and power section for handling large current are housed on the left and right sides, and the input equalizer amplifier and preamplifier for handling small signals are housed in the central box to eliminate mutual interference.The bottom chassis is also divided into 3 parts to reduce interference caused by chassis current.In order to shorten the signal transmission distance and simplify the transmission, the selector switch of the motor drive is located near the input pin jack, and the volume is also located near the selector with an independent 4-chain type of the shaft drive to connect the signal transmission distance as short as possible.The adoption of high-quality, low-impedance twin-roll Chemicon, high-speed diodes, and 70 Ï‰ m copper foil printed circuit board realizes low impedance circuits.Onkyo's proprietary technologies such as Delta Turbo Power Supply and Pre / Power Section Independent Super Servo Amplifier are used.It is equipped with functions such as source direct switch, direct tone circuit, tape monitor function, MC2 position cartridge selector, charge noise filter, etc.It comes with a remote control that allows you to control the power supply, volume, input selector and muting at your hand.The volume and input selector use a motor drive system to prevent non-linear distortion caused by semiconductor switches."

name: SCEPTER200
description: "A sound field type speaker system with a rear radiator to compensate for the indirect sound component of the band that is insufficient for ordinary speakers.In a normal 3-way system, the sound energy imbalance caused by the directional characteristics of the unit causes the sound pressure frequency characteristics on the axis to be flat, but the energy response shows a pattern of large undulations around the crossover frequency, and decreases as the frequency goes higher.To compensate for this unevenness in acoustic energy and to keep the ratio of direct and indirect sound constant over the whole fractional band, rear radiators are installed on the top and back of the enclosure. This rear radiator consists of three ways to compensate for the high range energy of each front unit.A 38 cm cone type woofer using Delta Olefin Refined Corn is installed in the low range.Delta Olefin Refined Corn is an improved version of conventional Delta Olefin. While maintaining the ideal internal loss, which is the greatest feature of Delta Olefin, the rigidity is enhanced by increasing Young's modulus by four times by controlling the added compound.In addition, a large magnet of 160 � x85 � x20tmm and a 4-layer long voice coil of 76 mm diameter are used for the magnetic circuit, and a butterfly damper made of glass-reinforced polyimide resin with excellent linearity is used for the damper.The middle section is equipped with a composite unit combining magnesium alloy and 10 cm cone.The diaphragm part uses a composite diaphragm composed of a magnesium alloy diaphragm of 65 � mm and 100 Ï‰ m thick and a 10 cm cone for both weight reduction and high rigidity. The composite diaphragm structure also stabilizes the suspension system such as weight reduction of the diaphragm and two point support.The magnetic circuit uses a strong magnet of 140 � x75 � x1tmm, magnetic flux density 12,000 gauss, total magnetic flux 127,000 maxwell, and the voice coil uses a 65 � mm voice coil.The edge has a special double support structure that supports the magnesium alloy diaphragm and cone, respectively.This mid-range unit has a back cavity with a capacity of 0.7l and a minimum resonance frequency of 240 Hz.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm uses a newly developed plastic vapor deposition method and a newly developed 40 Ï‰ m magnesium alloy diaphragm with a uniform coating as thin as 6 Ï‰ m. In addition, the foam rubber for braking, which had been strapping inside the dome part in order to suppress high-frequency resonance in the past, is removed, and efficiency is improved by 4-5 dB and wide-band characteristics up to 45 kHz are obtained.In addition to the use of a strong magnet, the magnetic circuit has a shape that makes it easy for the plate magnetic flux to concentrate. In addition, a magnetic fluid is injected into the gap, so that all the magnetic flux is concentrated in the voice coil.Furthermore, by adopting an equalizer based on computer analysis, we have improved the energy and directional characteristics between 10 kHz and 15 kHz.The Low-Mid radiator, which compensates for sound energy in the high-frequency range of the woofer, employs a 10 cm cone unit of a delta olefin diaphragm.The Mid-High radiator uses two 7 cm cone units and is fixed to a frame at an angle of 30 � to the baffle surface.The Super High radiator uses a ring-shaped diaphragm driven by a 35 mm diameter voice coil in combination with a conical horn with a three dimensional rotation angle of 90 �."

name: SCEPTER300
description: "A sound field type speaker system with a 3-way rear radiator system for indirect sound generation on the back to enhance the rich atmosphere and sense of presence unique to the live Symphony Hall.In addition to the normal 3-way system, the Scepter300 adds a rear radiator for reflected sound only for the band where energy is insufficient. By increasing the sound radiated backward, energy characteristics are made uniform.In addition, in order to realize the three points of Onkyo's design policy of expanding the dynamic range, expanding the playback range, and expanding the listening area, we are working to improve the quality of the system by introducing new technologies from both software and hardware aspects, such as the development of a magnesium alloy diaphragm and the development of a listening area measuring method and an energy response measuring method as design methods.A 38 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.In order to cope with the expansion of the dynamic range and to prevent bell vibration at high power, the rotary sheet-making cone with increased rigidity in the circumferential direction of cone paper is adopted. In addition, the heat radiation effect and heat resistance characteristics are improved by adding a reinforcing die-cast cap considering the heat radiation effect. The rigidity in the circumferential direction is increased approximately twice by the rotary sheet-making cone. In addition, the characteristics are improved by impregnating special resin into the cone paper, and at the same time, the rigidity and airtightness of the cone paper are increased.The magnetic circuit uses a strong magnet with a magnet size of 180 � x95 � x20tmm, a magnetic flux density of 11,500 gauss and a total magnetic flux of 258,000 maxwell, and a long voice coil with an aperture of 76 mm.In addition, a double damper made of polyimide fiber material, which does not change with time, is used for large input.The mid-range is equipped with a composite squaker that combines a magnesium alloy diaphragm with a 10 cm cone.With this composite diaphragm, we have achieved two and a half times the thickness and nearly seven times the strength of the conventional diaphragm, as well as a reduction in weight.The magnetic circuit uses a magnet with dimensions of 140 � x75 � x17tmm, total flux density of 12,000 gauss and total flux density of 127,000 maxwell, and a voice coil with a large diameter of 65 � mm. In addition, the edge section uses a double support structure that supports a magnesium-alloy diaphragm and carbon cone respectively, ensuring stable operation even when Dainyu is in use.In addition, a back cavity with a volume of 0.7L and a minimum resonance frequency of 240 Hz is installed in the squaker.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter with a magnesium alloy diaphragm is mounted in the high range.In this diaphragm, the foam rubber for braking, which had been used as a strapping in the inner surface of the dome part in order to suppress high-frequency resonance in the past, is removed, and dramatic improvement in efficiency of 4 to 5 dB and wide-band characteristics are realized.In addition, we are working to improve the energy characteristics of the tweeter region, which is on a decreasing trend compared with the woofer band and other regions. We are working to improve this by developing and adding new equalizers.In addition, magnetic fluid is injected into the gap of the magnetic circuit in the same way as before to suppress temperature rise of the voice coil, improve input resistance characteristics, and reduce harmonic distortion. In addition, the plate is shaped so that magnetic flux is easily concentrated, and all magnetic flux is concentrated in the voice coil.The rear radiator is a 3-way structure to compensate for the high-frequency RUNNET of each front unit. It is cut at 45 � to the top and rear of the enclosure so that it does not directly affect the characteristics of the front speakers. In addition, for low-mid radiators, a diffuse plate, which also serves as a reflection plate, is installed in the secondary radiator frame to prevent wraparound.For the Low-Mid, a 10 cm cone unit with a delta-olefin diaphragm is used as a radiator to compensate for sound energy in the high range of the woofer. The sound energy is expanded over a wide range by an diffuser incorporated in a sub RUNNET frame.Four 7 cm cone type speakers are used for Mid-High. They are mounted on a frame with an angle of 30 � to the baffle surface. Two of them are directed upward to the rear surface and the other two are directed upward to the left and right for uniform rear radiation.For Super High, we use a unit that combines a ring-shaped diaphragm driven by a 35 mm diameter voice coil with a conical horn with a three dimensional rotation angle of 90 �.Equipped with a bi-amplifier drive terminal, only the rear radiator can be disconnected and connected separately.It can be used when you want to increase the energy of the indirect sound component or when you want to change the frequency characteristics of the indirect sound component with a graphic equalizer according to the acoustic characteristics of the room.Equipped with independent level control for the Skoka Tweeter and each rear radiator."

name: INTEGRAA-DS939
description: "This AV amplifier is a prestige model developed for the highest grade.The Dolby Digital Decoder uses a 24-bit DSP developed by Motorola Inc. of the United States.In the Dolby Digital System, all processing is done digitally, and the operation itself of the decoding processing DSP greatly affects sound quality. However, the Motorola DSP (56009) performs internal operation with accuracy of 24 bits or more and repeats complicated calculation with an operation capacity of 440 full bloom per second, ensuring sufficient accuracy as a Dolby Digital Decoder.In addition, its low power consumption, low thermal fluctuation and low noise generation reduce the influence on analog circuits and ensure excellent dynamic range.The Home THX Cinema position was created to make the most of the performance of Dolby Digital and to enjoy the sound field of the film mixing studio by the assumption, and the sound recorded in Dolby Digital can be reproduced on THX.In order to achieve more realistic surround sound at home, it is equipped with DSP processing such as a cinema-re-equalizer that adjusts the high-frequency range to an appropriate level, timber-matching that adjusts sound from the front and sound from the rear to be heard smoothly, and dynamic decorrelation that creates the lowest surround sound field.The power amplifier is equipped with a non-feedback circuit (NonNFB) that is not easily affected by the back electromotive force from the speaker.Furthermore, based on the design philosophy of Integra, we carefully select key parts for circuit design, from transistors, capacitors, power transformers to resistors, and further develop and incorporate custom parts to improve sound quality.The main settings of the AV amplifier (system setup, surround set, input selector set, etc.) are displayed on the screen and can be operated with a remote control.Equipped with an Auto Room Acoustic Analizer (ARAA) function, the attached measuring microphone measures the Speaker Distance (the distance from the listening position to each speaker) and Level Calibration (the volume of each speaker) in approximately 1 minute and 30 seconds, and automatically sets the delay time of the signal from the speakers and the sound pressure of each speaker.As a result, sound fields can be reproduced uniformly and the phase characteristics of each channel are improved, so that the sense of orientation and depth can be reproduced in the best condition.It uses an IPM (Intelligent Power Management) system and automatically turns the power of the amplifier on and off when the power of the TV is turned on and off.In addition, when it is turned ON, the surround mode set up in advance is called up (when another device is selected as the source, the power ON/OFF is not linked).The Y/C MIX function is installed so that the Y/C separated video signal input to the amplifier at the S jack name: TX-DS575
description: "An AV amplifier equipped with a Dolby digital and DTS signal decoder, and also equipped with new technology for DVD-Audio.The 24-bit HD (High Definition) DSP in the DSP section realizes high-quality decoding of Dolby digital and DTS signals.In addition, it is equipped with a 5.1 ch analog input terminal and can be extended to DVD-Audio and SACD.WRAT (Wide Range Amplifier Technology), a new wide-range technology, was introduced to support DVD-Audio.At WRAT, by examining the parts and circuit configuration, dependence on NFB circuits is eliminated as much as possible, and a wide range of bare characteristics is achieved.The TX-DS575 takes note of the fact that the audio signal passing through the amplifier itself changes the ground potential, so it is possible to propagate the audio signal more accurately. name: TX-DS989
description: "AV amplifier equipped with THX Ultra certified 7 ch amplifier.The TX-DS989 is available in early and late models.The latter model is equipped with Dolby Pro Logic II, DTS-ES and MPEG-2 AAC decoder in addition to the same configuration as the former model, and each mark is written on the front panel.In addition, during the period from April 2001 to April 2003, an upgrade service was provided for the early model, and the early model was compatible with Dolby Pro Logic II, DTS-ES, and MPEG-2 AAC.Equipped with an THX Ultra certified 7-channel amplifier, it realizes the spread of a front sound field that perfectly localizes to the image targeted by THX and a rear sound field that creates natural surround feeling.In addition to the conventional 5.1 channels, the THX Surround EX decoder uses a surround back channel to further enhance the sense of diffusion in the rear sound field. name: TX-SA500
description: "AV amplifier equipped with Dolby Pro Logic II and MPEG-2 AAC decoder.In addition to DTS and Dolby Digital, it is equipped with a Dolby Pro Logic II decoder capable of 5.1 channel playback from a 2-channel sound source, and an MPEG-2 AAC decoder, an audio format for BS digital broadcasting.A new design has been adopted for the amplifier section.The design layout is designed to minimize noise by increasing the depth of the casing and shortening the wiring between circuit boards. contamination.All channels use a screw-type speaker terminal that supports banana plugs.Equipped with digital / analog automatic input switching function.It is equipped with a late night mode in which you can listen to the dialogue even in low volume playback such as at night, and large sound effects are limited to the degree.This function can be used when playing Dolby Digital.Onkyo's unique name: E-83ANEWMKIII
description: "Based on the E-83AmkIII, this is an upgraded speaker system with new mid-range and low-range units and improved high-range units.In the low range, it is equipped with W-3024E which is a 30 cm cone type woofer with technology developed in the Ceptor and materials.The diaphragm uses a mixed cone made of two types of Finnish pulp with different physical properties. It is finished with a curved curved cone that is effective for sound quality. In addition, the edge uses neoprene foam rubber edge that has good followability and prevents mechanical strain such as horizontal deflection of the cone. This realizes fo = 20 Hz for the woofer alone.The voice coil is an edge-wise wound voice coil, and a long voice coil with a winding width of approximately 20 mm using an aluminum foil bobbin ensures good propagation characteristics.In the middle area, the diffusion horn squawker of the Septor unit HM-450A is mounted as it is in the MD-301001C which is a type without external surface makeup only.The diffusion horn is designed so that the sound path of the horn becomes longer at the peripheral part. By changing the sound wave inside the horn into a spherical wave, the directivity, which was a weak point of the horn type, is greatly improved.In addition, the diaphragm is made of ultra-hard Djelal Min-foil, and active air damping is performed in the back cavity, so that transient characteristics and strain characteristics are improved and the low-frequency reproduction range is expanded.A newly designed double equalizer has been adopted in the horn throat section. By making the slit double, the sound emitted from each part of the diaphragm becomes opposite phase in the slit section and cancels out each other to shorten the wavelength, thus improving the high-frequency characteristics.As a result of these measures, although the cut-off frequency is as low as 450 Hz, the horn length is shortened and miniaturized by the diffusion horn, and the high band is extended to 1.3 kHz by the adoption of the double equalizer, realizing a wide band.A horn type tweeter TW-611A is mounted in the high range.The horn section has a sufficient horn load and employs a precision die-cast extrinsic horn that reduces internal reflection and material noise. The surface of the horn is treated with a malt-plane treatment that increases the apparent length of the horn and improves braking, resulting in excellent transient characteristics. This malt-plane treatment also reduces reflection inside the horn and increases the naturalness of the reproduced sound.The diaphragm is made of ultra-hard duralumin foil developed by Septor, and combined with the magnetic circuit with magnetic flux density of 14,500 gauss, smooth response is realized.Low-loss LC network is used in the network section.It is also equipped with 5-step level control for mid-range and high-range, and can be adjusted within ¥2 dB.The enclosure is sealed, with hard chipboard for the front baffle, lauan plywood for other areas, and a walnut finish for the exterior.Equipped with multi-terminals, 3-way multi-amplifier drive is possible."

description: "An MC head amplifier that improves the S/N ratio by taking advantage of the frequency characteristics and distortion factor characteristic of a head amplifier for electronic circuits.In order to improve the S/N ratio, a source feedback amplifier circuit is adopted.The equivalent noise resistance of the input stage of a source-feedback amplifier circuit is 1 / 2 of that of a general differential amplifier often used in the first stage because of its excellent DC performance. name: FRX20
description: "A 20 cm cone type full range unit that uses specially molded 2-layer urethane edge and elliptical cone technology.A newly developed special elliptical cone is used for the diaphragm.This diaphragm uses a composite curve calculated using a computer to suppress peaks and dips in the middle and high frequencies, which are the most problematic in the large diameter full range. name: INTEGRAA-701XG
description: "Pre-main amplifier with built-in D/A converter that adopts BI-MOS drive amplifier.It is an optical / coaxial digital amplifier with an analog base of A-817XG and an 18-bit optical D/A converter protected by a shield case.In the D/A converter section, real 18-bit D/A converters are mounted independently on the left and right sides.In addition, in order to achieve excellent linearity during reproduction of a small signal, the ACCU BIT4The system is installed, and the error of ladder network which slightly occurs is adjusted for upper 4 bits of right and left respectively.This improves the linearity for small signals.It uses a 2 PLL digital interface demodulation circuit that reliably captures digital input signals and reduces distortion on the time axis of analog output, and an 8 x oversampling digital filter that cuts noise components.In addition, the digital circuit is shielded with a pure copper shield case to suppress noise emission to the analog section.The digital input coaxial automatic switching circuits are used for digital input, and a coaxial Route 3, two optical input systems, and digital out (coaxial) are installed.The sampling frequency can be confirmed by the 32/44.1/48kHz digital lock indicator.The digital part is equipped with an auto digital OFF circuit that shuts off the digital noise by turning off the power to suppress the digital noise when the digital input is not heard.The BI-MOS drive amplifier has an output stage for each of a MOS FET and a bipolar transistor, and drives a speaker by both of them. As the input voltage increases, the MOS FET rises first and then the bipolar transistor rises.As a result, the BI-MOS composite characteristic shows the characteristic of the gentle rise curve of the MOS FET in the small current region, and the characteristic of the stretch and linear characteristic of the bipolar transistor becomes dominant in the large current region.As a result, the overall + / - characteristics are very close to a straight line in the crossover region, and excellent linearity characteristics with elongation even in the large amplitude region are realized.We have developed and adopted a laser transformer to prevent the power transformer from generating magnetic leakage flux and harmful noise caused by magnetic induction in the amplifier circuit.This laser transformer uses a new type of EI core with a wider outer circumference than the standard one. This reduces the magnetic resistance of the outer circumference and makes it difficult for magnetic flux to leak from the core.In addition, the area around the core is carefully shielded with silicon steel shielding material, and the area around the coil is also shielded to prevent flux leakage.As a result, the leakage flux is reduced to 1 / 20 compared with the conventional EI transformer.It comes standard with a wireless remote control that controls the input selector and volume at hand.In addition, it uses a motor-driven mechanical system to suppress the occurrence of non-linear distortion like semiconductor switches and to prevent adverse effects on sound quality.The video input / output jacks are installed Route 3 to enable Iori, recording, playback and BGV playback.An optical drive and a current converter are used in the differential amplifier circuit at the first stage of the power amplifier circuit to obtain a stable reference voltage without fluctuation from the light energy produced by the photovoltaic element.A voltage / current (V-I) conversion circuit using an operational amplifier generates a constant current and drives a differential amplifier circuit.This suppresses unstable operation caused by fluctuation components due to music signals and power supply ripple fluctuations.In order to eliminate interference between each stage and to realize pure signal transmission without causing unnecessary current to flow in the ground line between stages, the secondary winding of the power transformer is separated into power amplifier, EQ amplifier, microcomputer, D/A converter, etc.The input, voltage amplification section and power amplification section are separated by sandwiching a heat sink. In addition, the power supply section and microcomputer section are also independent and shielded, and block separation construction is adopted which completely eliminates mutual interference.In order to reproduce all music signals with high purity, it is equipped with a source direct switch that sends the source directly to the power amplifier via a dedicated volume.When the position is set to TONE, it can be adjusted by direct tone, and when the position is set to Processor-TONE, it can be controlled by an external device such as a connected Gray.The power supply Chemi-Con employs a large capacity, low impedance twin-roll Chemi-Con and high-speed diodes for all power supply rectifier diodes.In addition, we use carefully selected parts such as die-cast detent type volume, gold-plated pin jack, large speaker terminal, and AC cord with polarity display."

description: "A pre-main amplifier of the RX series that employs a double sensing servo system.In the double sensing servo system, in addition to the conventional negative feedback, servo feedback is applied to the input side of the amplifier through the servo amplifier from both the + terminal and - terminal of the speaker.The servo on the + side cuts out harmful noise components at very low frequencies, and the servo on the - side cancels out distortion and noise components caused by electromotive force in the impedance of the earth line, and controls the - terminal of the speaker precisely.This makes it possible to drive accurately not only the + terminal but also the - terminal of the speaker.It uses a simple two amplifier configuration with only an equalizer amplifier and a power amplifier section with a double sensing servo system. name: INTEGRAA-815RXII
description: "This is a real-phase <digital> amplifier that verifies the effect of digital signals on the amplifier and takes full-scale measures for digital signals.The Real Phase <Digital> amplifier uses two in-phase transformers, an input in-phase transformer and a power in-phase transformer, to prevent external noise from entering the amplifier circuit.In addition, a charge noise filter is used to eliminate normal mode noise that is superimposed on home AC lines and enters by microwave ovens and other high-frequency equipment.The input-in-phase transformer prevents common-mode noise from the ground line of the other device when connected to the amplifier. This transformer is connected between hot and ground in the input circuit and eliminates noise without affecting the music signal.The power-in-phase transformer eliminates common-mode noise from the AC line and cancels the noise that enters the amplifier circuit from the secondary side of the power transformer. The power-in-phase transformer also cancels the phase shift signal that occurs when a speaker is connected, and helps improve the phase characteristics of the amplifier.The tone control circuit uses a volume circuit instead of a tone amplifier, and uses a direct tone system composed only of passive elements with little degradation in sound quality.In addition to the general bass and treble, it is equipped with a contrabus that boosts the band below 100 hz. It can boost only the very low band while suppressing the influence of vocals and other sounds on the mid-range.Uses a double sensing servo system that controls both + - ends of the speaker."

I.), which reduces sound field and SN sensation.This digital interference is a harmonic noise component and flows in a loop with the CD player, amplifier, power line, and CD player.The Integra A-815EX has a signal-in-phase transformer (S. I. T) in the CD input, which removes only high-frequency digital noise without affecting the music signal.In order to achieve low impedance in the power supply section, a newly developed low impedance twin roll Chemi-Con with a total capacity of 24,000 Ï‰ F is used in the electrolytic capacitor. name: INTEGRAA-817
description: "Pre-main amplifier with dual direct amplifier configuration using W / Super Servo system.The W / Super Servo system is incorporated into the power amplifier and equalizer amplifier.This system feeds back only the extra noise and distortion components contained in the signal other than the music signal from both positive and negative poles of the amplifier output terminal via a servo operational circuit, and cancels the feedback. On the negative side, the electromotive force induced by the impedance of the power supply is suppressed.Moreover, we have dramatically improved the resolution of reproduced sound by suppressing it without relying on capacitors and other devices that are problematic in terms of sound quality.Linear switching method is adopted for the transistor operation of the final stage.This method is the same as Class B in that it is amplified by two transistors, but the linearity of the joint of the operation curve, which is a problem in this case, is corrected by a special bias circuit to obtain linear operation characteristics.And High fTBy using a power transistor, the switching distortion can be suppressed to a completely negligible range.To support MC cartridge, MC straight equalizer amplifier is mounted.It has a high gain design with MC as the main role, and it can be directly connected to the equalizer without putting any extra things in between.It is also possible to switch between MC and High MC depending on the output voltage.Uses a direct tone system.In this method, as the gain of the power amplifier increases, the tone amplifier is omitted, and the tone is changed by the loudness circuit related to the volume control. Therefore, it is composed only of passive elements with no problem in sound quality, so that the change in sound quality caused by the use of tone hardly becomes a problem.Uses an auto tracking bias system that detects temperature differences in the final stage and always supplies a stable bias.Non-magnetic material is used to suppress the generation of higher harmonic waves."

description: "Pre-main amplifier with supercharger power supply and optical drive amplifier.Unlike conventional power supplies, we have developed a supercharger circuit that can continuously charge the Chemi-Con is mounted on both the + side and - side.The supercharger does not have ripple fluctuations of 100Hz/120Hz. This force flows into the output stage of the amplifier and causes time difference distortion, which is reduced by a special linearity correction circuit.The servo circuit applied to both poles of the output side of the amplifier suppresses noise to less than -40dB, which causes distortion due to harmful ultra-low frequency components and total impedance of the power supply.The MC straight equalizer and power amplifier are all part of the simple design. The equalizer amplifier is a high-gain design for MC cartridges.The Direct Tone Control method is used for tone control.Since the tone amplifier, which had many problems in sound quality, is omitted and the tone is changed by using the loudness circuit related to volume control, the circuit configuration can be made only with passive elements which have no problem in sound quality.Onkyo has adopted a linear switching system originally developed by Onkyo. By using a special linearity correction circuit, the crossover characteristics equal to those of class A can be obtained with high efficiency class B amplification.The chassis uses non-magnetic parts that do not affect sound quality."

name: INTEGRAA-817RXII
description: "This pre-main amplifier is equipped with the same functions as the Integra A-815RXII and achieves high power.The Real Phase <Digital> amplifier uses two in-phase transformers, an input in-phase transformer and a power in-phase transformer, to prevent external noise from entering the amplifier circuit.In addition, a charge noise filter is used to eliminate normal mode noise that is superimposed on home AC lines and enters by microwave ovens and other high-frequency equipment.The input-in-phase transformer prevents common-mode noise from the ground line of the other device when connected to the amplifier. This transformer is connected between hot and ground in the input circuit and eliminates noise without affecting the music signal.The power-in-phase transformer eliminates common-mode noise from the AC line and cancels the noise that enters the amplifier circuit from the secondary side of the power transformer. The power-in-phase transformer also cancels the phase shift signal that occurs when a speaker is connected, and helps improve the phase characteristics of the amplifier.The tone control circuit uses a volume circuit instead of a tone amplifier, and uses a direct tone system composed only of passive elements with little degradation in sound quality.In addition to the general bass and treble, it is equipped with a contrabus that boosts the band below 100 hz. It can boost only the very low band while suppressing the influence of vocals and other sounds on the mid-range.Uses a double sensing servo system that controls both + - ends of the speaker."

name: INTEGRAA-817XX
description: "This pre-main amplifier is equipped with a real-phase <digital> amplifier and a W stabilizer system to improve the quality of playback sound by increasing the linearity during low sound.In order to prevent dynamic distortion that occurs when the linearity of the power stage temporarily deteriorates when the signal level changes inside the amplifier, and acoustic distortion that occurs when the amplifier vibrates due to sound pressure from the speakers, we have adopted a new real phase <digital> amplifier configuration using the newly developed W stabilizer method.In the New Real Phase <Digital> amplifier, dynamic distortion is solved by a DD (Dynamic Distortion) stabilizer circuit, and acoustic distortion is solved by a new structure called X stabilizer.The DD stabilizer circuit detects dynamic distortion at the power stage and cancels this distortion component by subtracting it from the signal at the driver stage.In addition, the X stabilizer was created from the idea of attaching a strong base to the chassis of the amplifier itself. The X-shaped structure made of high-rigidity PbSb special alloy reduces chassis vibration.A real-phase <digital> amplifier configuration is adopted in which an in-phase transformer is added to the input terminal and power supply, which are input paths of disturbance signals from the outside.A signal-in-phase transformer (S. I. T) is installed at the input terminal and a power-in-phase transformer (P. I. T) is installed at the power supply section to guard the amplifier circuit, preventing the penetration of external noise and achieving high-purity transmission.A charge noise filter is also added to the power supply to eliminate normal mode noise that enters from the AC line.The power-in-phase transformer inserted into the power supply circuit not only eliminates common-mode noise but also eliminates the phase shift of the charging current of the power supply and transmits correct phase information.The power-in-phase transformer combines charging currents with opposite phases on the + side and - side to generate a charging current with a certain peak, and removes out-of-phase information from the charging current. This improves the driving performance of the speaker and the braking performance in the low-frequency range.In order to achieve high-purity transmission, we have taken various circuit measures, such as eliminating the contact point of the Tape Monitor switch and adopting the Rec Selector method, removing the Tone amplifier from the signal path and adopting the Direct Tone method using the center tap of the volume, and removing the Muting switch from the signal path and placing it in the Direct Tone circuit.It is equipped with a CD Direct switch. When this switch is pressed, the signal is sent directly to the dedicated 4-channel volume without passing through any contact points, which enables high-purity transmission.In order to cope with the low impedance of speakers, a powerful power supply with a margin and a power transistor connected in parallel are adopted. Even if the load temporarily changes to low impedance such as 2 ¥, stable driving is possible.In addition to the Treble/Bass, the tone control is equipped with a Contrabass that boosts the band below approximately 100 Hz.This allows you to boost the low range without affecting the middle range of vocals.In addition, it employs a new circuit that provides a boost of up to 20 dB when muting is on. If you use the Contrabass with muting on in the middle of the night, for example, you can enjoy rich bass playback even at a low volume.Each of the Tape1rec, Tape2rec and Video Mode has an off position. When recording is not performed, the off position allows the recording system to be separated from the signal system, ensuring high-purity transmission.In order to prevent the video signal line from adversely affecting the audio signal line, a remote switching method using a relay is adopted for video signal switching. The layout is separated from the audio circuit by processing the video signal in close proximity to the pin jack."

name: INTEGRAA-817EX
description: "Stereo pre-main amplifier with optical drive system.The power amplifier section uses a newly developed optical drive system.In this method, the reference current of the first stage differential amplifier circuit is obtained from a photovoltaic element that generates a constant voltage when light is irradiated. By obtaining a reference current with higher accuracy than that of the conventional method, highly accurate V to I conversion is performed.In order to prevent magnetic flux from entering the amplifier circuit from the power supply part, the power supply block is separated from other circuits, and the top cover is made independent to realize a complete two box structure.Each of the two top covers is firmly attached with 6 ¥4 mm screws to suppress vibration caused by sound pressure.Furthermore, the amplifier block is divided into a large enclosure-type heat sink, a current amplifier stage closed loop with a barrier, and a driver voltage amplifier stage, each of which is shielded to prevent electromagnetic coupling.A large heat sink is used to surround the power stage in order to cut off interference from the power stage handling large current to the voltage amplification stage processing small signals.In this enclosure-type heat sink, the radiation fins are arranged independently on the left and right, and the fins are designed to have unequal lengths to disperse resonance. In addition, a vibration control structure using a special damper is also added.The power supply section uses a large power transformer with a capacity of 250 VA and a weight of 5 kg, a twin-roll Chemicon with low impedance, and a high-speed diode with a recovery time of 1/10 of the conventional one.The Twin-Roll Chemi-Con has a structure in which two pairs of positive and negative foils are wound in one case. By connecting two pairs of foils reinforced to 2.5 times the thickness of the negative foils in parallel inside, the internal resistance is reduced to 1/3 of the impedance.In addition, a rubber type absorber is used for the transformer part to provide damping measures.In order to protect the amplifier circuit from external vibration, a special alloy hexabalance base is adopted. The chassis frame is directly mounted on this base to suppress external vibration such as floor vibration and sound pressure.In addition, the Hexa Balance Base adopts a 6-point grounding structure, and by adding two legs closer to the power supply section, we have succeeded in balancing the overall weight.In order to transmit all music signals with high purity, it is equipped with a source direct switch that sends the source directly to the power amplifier via a dedicated volume."

name: INTEGRAA-817XG
description: "Pre-main amplifier that adopts BI-MOS drive amplifier.The BI-MOS drive amplifier has an output stage for each of a MOS FET and a bipolar transistor, and drives a speaker by both of them. As the input voltage increases, the MOS FET rises first and then the bipolar transistor rises.As a result, the BI-MOS composite characteristic shows the characteristic of the gentle rise curve of the MOS FET in the small current region, and the characteristic of the stretch and linear characteristic of the bipolar transistor becomes dominant in the large current region.As a result, the overall + / - characteristics are very close to a straight line in the crossover region, and excellent linearity characteristics with elongation even in the large amplitude region are realized.We have developed and adopted a laser transformer to prevent the power transformer from generating magnetic leakage flux and harmful noise caused by magnetic induction in the amplifier circuit.This laser transformer uses a new type of EI core with a wider outer circumference than the standard one. This reduces the magnetic resistance of the outer circumference and makes it difficult for magnetic flux to leak from the core.In addition, the area around the core is carefully shielded with silicon steel shielding material, and the area around the coil is also shielded to prevent flux leakage.As a result, the leakage flux is reduced to 1 / 20 compared with the conventional EI transformer.It comes standard with a wireless remote control that controls the input selector and volume at hand.In addition, it uses a motor-driven mechanical system to suppress the occurrence of non-linear distortion like semiconductor switches and to prevent adverse effects on sound quality.The video input / output jacks are installed Route 3 to enable Iori, recording, playback and BGV playback.An optical drive and a current converter are used in the differential amplifier circuit at the first stage of the power amplifier circuit to obtain a stable reference voltage without fluctuation from the light energy produced by the photovoltaic element.A voltage / current (V-I) conversion circuit using an operational amplifier generates a constant current and drives a differential amplifier circuit.This suppresses unstable operation caused by fluctuation components due to music signals and power supply ripple fluctuations.In order to eliminate interference between each stage and to realize pure signal transmission without causing unnecessary current to flow in the ground line between stages, the secondary winding of the power transformer is separated into power amplifier, EQ amplifier, microcomputer, etc.The input, voltage amplification section and power amplification section are separated by sandwiching a heat sink. In addition, the power supply section and microcomputer section are also independent and shielded, and block separation construction is adopted which completely eliminates mutual interference.In order to reproduce all music signals with high purity, it is equipped with a source direct switch that sends the source directly to the power amplifier via a dedicated volume.When the position is set to TONE, it can be adjusted by direct tone, and when the position is set to Processor-TONE, it can be controlled by an external device such as a connected Gray.The power supply Chemi-Con employs a large capacity, low impedance twin-roll Chemi-Con and high-speed diodes for all power supply rectifier diodes.In addition, we use carefully selected parts such as die-cast detent type volume, gold-plated pin jack, large speaker terminal, and AC cord with polarity display."

name: INTEGRAA-819RS
description: "The pre-main amplifier of the RS series is fully compatible with digital sources by adopting the super turbo system.In the Super Turbo system, the power transformer, which generates harmful modulation noise components inside the amplifier, is separated from the amplifier purely electrically. This system extends the dynamic dynamic range by 20 dB.In this system, when a low audio signal of 100 Hz or less is input to the amplifier, noise caused by � imbalance in the power supply is prevented by using a delta turbo circuit, and noise caused by signal magnitude is prevented by using a turbo filter circuit.Onkyo's unique super servo integral system is adopted.This method completely eliminates intermodulation distortion that occurs when the electromotive force induced in the speaker flows into the output stage with a time lag due to external factors such as the sound pressure of other channels.In addition, servo feedback is applied to the input side from both the + and - sides of the output side of the amplifier, and harmful noise components especially at very low frequencies are cut off, and noise components generated in the impedance accumulated by various resistance components in the ground line are suppressed.In order to faithfully amplify complex music signal waveforms, a simple structure has been realized. name: INTEGRAA-819RX
description: "This is a real phase stereo pre-main amplifier with in-phase transformer to improve the phase shift.The amplifier supplies the speaker current according to the input signal (voltage). However, since the impedance changes suddenly near the fo of the speaker, a phase shift of approximately ¥90 � occurs between the input signal and the speaker current. This out-of-phase speaker current is sent from the power supply through the current amplifier section of the amplifier. In conventional amplifiers, it affects the voltage amplifier section and disturbs the upper phase of the music signal.To solve this problem, we added Onkyo's unique power in-phase transformer to the power supply, which is the source of the speaker current, and adopted a double transformer drive system that drives with two transformers, eliminating the voltage generated by the phase shift of the speaker current.This power-in-phase transformer has a high coupling degree of K = 0.99. It combines the charge current with the opposite phase of + - and creates a charge current with a constant peak. This eliminates out-of-phase information from the charge current and transmits correct phase information.A power-in-phase transformer eliminates common-mode noise.In a power-in-phase transformer, the charging current on the positive and negative sides is at the same level with a constant peak, so no current flows between the transformer midpoint and the ground. Furthermore, the transformer midpoint is grounded, so common-mode noise is bypassed through the ground line and does not adversely affect sound quality.All the circuit technologies developed in the Integra Series have been adopted, and the quality has been improved by installing a double sensing servo system that uses a servo amplifier from both + - terminals of the speaker for servo feedback, a two amplifier configuration consisting of a high-gain equalizer and a power amplifier, and a direct tone circuit.Along with the low impedance of speakers, we have adopted a power supply with a margin and a parallel-connected power transistor so that instantaneous values of 2 to 3 � will not be a problem.Equipped with a charge noise filter to block power supply noise.Uses a low-distortion linear switching system that realizes the distortion characteristics equivalent to class A.Compatible with low impedance MC cartridge.A super stabilizer is adopted to eliminate the adverse effect of external vibration."

name: INTEGRAA-819XX
description: "Aiming for digital reference, this pre-main amplifier is designed to improve the reproduction capability by implementing high-purity transmission through simplification of the real-phase <digital> amplifier configuration and circuit configuration.It is basically the same configuration as the A-817XX, and the output is strengthened.In order to prevent dynamic distortion that occurs when the linearity of the power stage temporarily deteriorates when the signal level changes inside the amplifier, and acoustic distortion that occurs when the amplifier vibrates due to sound pressure from the speakers, we have adopted a new real phase <digital> amplifier configuration using the newly developed W stabilizer method.In the New Real Phase <Digital> amplifier, dynamic distortion is solved by a DD (Dynamic Distortion) stabilizer circuit, and acoustic distortion is solved by a new structure called X stabilizer.The DD stabilizer circuit detects dynamic distortion at the power stage and cancels this distortion component by subtracting it from the signal at the driver stage.In addition, the X stabilizer was created from the idea of attaching a strong base to the chassis of the amplifier itself. The X-shaped structure made of high-rigidity PbSb special alloy reduces chassis vibration.A real-phase <digital> amplifier configuration is adopted in which an in-phase transformer is added to the input terminal and power supply, which are input paths of disturbance signals from the outside.A signal-in-phase transformer (S. I. T) is installed at the input terminal and a power-in-phase transformer (P. I. T) is installed at the power supply section to guard the amplifier circuit, preventing the penetration of external noise and achieving high-purity transmission.A charge noise filter is also added to the power supply to eliminate normal mode noise that enters from the AC line.The power-in-phase transformer inserted into the power supply circuit not only eliminates common-mode noise but also eliminates the phase shift of the charging current of the power supply and transmits correct phase information.The power-in-phase transformer combines charging currents with opposite phases on the + side and - side to generate a charging current with a certain peak, and removes out-of-phase information from the charging current. This improves the driving performance of the speaker and the braking performance in the low-frequency range.In order to achieve high-purity transmission, we have taken various circuit measures, such as eliminating the contact point of the Tape Monitor switch and adopting the Rec Selector method, removing the Tone amplifier from the signal path and adopting the Direct Tone method using the center tap of the volume, and removing the Muting switch from the signal path and placing it in the Direct Tone circuit.It is equipped with a CD Direct switch. When this switch is pressed, the signal is sent directly to the dedicated 4-channel volume without passing through any contact points, which enables high-purity transmission.In order to cope with the low impedance of speakers, a powerful power supply with a margin and a power transistor connected in parallel are adopted. Even if the load temporarily changes to low impedance such as 2 ¥, stable driving is possible.In addition to the Treble/Bass, the tone control is equipped with a Contrabass that boosts the band below approximately 100 Hz.This allows you to boost the low range without affecting the middle range of vocals.In addition, it employs a new circuit that provides a boost of up to 20 dB when muting is on. If you use the Contrabass with muting on in the middle of the night, for example, you can enjoy rich bass playback even at a low volume.Each of the Tape1rec, Tape2rec and Video Mode has an off position. When recording is not performed, the off position allows the recording system to be separated from the signal system, ensuring high-purity transmission."

name: INTEGRAA-820RS
description: "The RS series top-of-the-line pre-main amplifier is fully compatible with digital sources by adopting the super turbo system.In the Super Turbo system, the power transformer, which generates harmful modulation noise components inside the amplifier, is separated from the amplifier purely electrically. This system extends the dynamic dynamic range by 20 dB.In this system, when a low audio signal of 100 Hz or less is input to the amplifier, noise caused by � imbalance in the power supply is prevented by using a delta turbo circuit, and noise caused by signal magnitude is prevented by using a turbo filter circuit.Onkyo's unique super servo integral system is adopted.This method completely eliminates intermodulation distortion that occurs when the electromotive force induced in the speaker flows into the output stage with a time lag due to external factors such as the sound pressure of other channels.In addition, servo feedback is applied to the input side from both the + and - sides of the output side of the amplifier, and harmful noise components especially at very low frequencies are cut off, and noise components generated in the impedance accumulated by various resistance components in the ground line are suppressed.In order to faithfully amplify complex music signal waveforms, a simple structure has been realized. It consists of a straight high-gain equalizer for MC and a two amplifier configuration with only the power section. The tone control circuit also uses direct tone.Direct Tone does not use a tone amplifier and is composed only of passive elements that have little effect on sound quality. It enables high quality sound without tone degradation.It is equipped with a soft circuit that controls the resolution and makes it easier to listen when connected to extremely low-grade program sources or devices such as extremely low-quality cartridges or speaker systems.In order to prevent vibration from the outside, a super stabilizer is installed as a special structural reinforcement.The power amplifier uses a linear switching method developed by Onkyo, which reduces crossover distortion by improving the linearity of the circuit operation without changing the bias. Although the operation of the circuit is class B, the sound quality is close to class A.In additionTBy using a power transistor, the effect of switching distortion is suppressed.Non-magnetic chassis is used for the main parts of the chassis to reduce the generation of harmful high-order harmonics.The A-820RS uses a large complete 2-transformer system."

name: INTEGRAA-2001
description: "A pre-main amplifier that combines a high-purity amplifier circuit with a simple transmission circuit, and also incorporates a D/A converter.The power amplifier section uses a newly developed optical drive system.In this method, the reference current of the first stage differential amplifier circuit is obtained from a photovoltaic element that generates a constant voltage when light is irradiated. By obtaining a reference current with higher accuracy than that of the conventional method, highly accurate V to I conversion is performed.In the final stage of the power block, a parallel push-pull system composed of four large output transistors with a collector loss of 150W is adopted to realize an output with a margin.To prevent interference between analog and digital circuits in the power supply section, a dedicated power transformer is used for digital circuits, and a super-large power transformer with windings for each secondary side Line 5 is installed for analog circuits.The rectifier and smoothing circuit employs eight low-impedance twin-roll Chemi-Cons (96,000 Ï‰ F) with a resistance value one third of that of conventional ones, and a high-speed rectifier diode with a fast recovery time to provide a stable current supply.In order to prevent adverse effects of vibration, we have adopted a high carbon steel rigid chassis with high density, high mass and excellent vibration resolution capability. All components such as power transformers and amplifier circuit boards are mounted on this base.This chassis has a 6-point mounting structure that ensures a stable setting by balancing the weight of the Integra A-2001.In order to prevent distortion due to mutual interference of each circuit, four block complete separate construction is adopted.The power supply block is placed at the end of the box and completely separated by a shield plate. Furthermore, the light-driven D/A converter and the digital processing circuit are each enclosed in an electromagnetically shielded copper-plated case and separated on the opposite side from the power supply.The digital circuit is equipped with a newly developed real 18-bit optically driven twin D/A converter."
