name: D-77FX
description: "A bookshelf type speaker system equipped with a MID4 concept bio-cross cone unit and SH horn.The MID4 concept is an idea that focuses on vocal expression, and by covering four octaves from 120 Hz to 2000 Hz with one unit, music can be played without failure.A 27 cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.High internal loss type pure cross carbon is used for the diaphragm, and the unique resonance dispersion structure realizes deep low sound reproduction.In addition, both the diaphragm and edge have been reduced by 15%.16 cm cone type skoker is used for the middle area.In order to cover four octaves from 120 Hz to 2000 Hz, which is the main band of vocals, with one unit, the diaphragm has a balanced 16 cm diameter. In addition, we have developed and adopted an ultra-lightweight (2.6g) adopted an ultra-lightweight (g) been developed and is used for the diaphragm.Biochloroscone is a mixture of wood pulp produced in high latitudes near the Arctic and refined cellulose, which is highly crystalline among natural cellulose. As a result of the formation of the paper layer network by integrating these two types of cellulose, the confidentiality is improved.For the high-frequency band, we have adopted the SH horn (SH horn), which was developed when the Grand Scepter GS-1 was designed, as a prototype model, and the SH horn tweeter, which was developed by taking advantage of the know-how of the SH horn.The change of Horn cross-section is determined by hyperbolic function, and the change of shape is determined by superelliptic function including oblate function and shape function by solving simultaneous equations.In addition, we have taken thorough measures to eliminate multipath ghost distortion, which is a problem in horn sound quality, in terms of horn shape and structure.In addition, the gap adjustment between the diaphragm and phase plug, which is an important factor determining the sound quality of the horn type, is designed to make the gap as narrow as possible. We have developed our own new technology to achieve more stable performance, and have achieved mass production of high-precision horns.This new technology improves the accuracy of the height and shape of the diaphragm by the ultra-precision press method and streamlines the manufacturing process by using the slide-type pole piece. This makes it possible to control the total number with high accuracy and narrow gap.Each unit is provided with anti-magnetic measures using a cancel magnet to suppress leakage flux.This prevents the influence of magnetic fields on the choke coils in the network and protects cathode ray tubes and other objects.In the network section, the circuit board for each unit is divided, and all parts that need to be divided up into circuits and parts are divided to create a high-purity network with no interference and little distortion.The enclosure uses an acoustic wave regulator consisting of a slit and a chamber to suppress standing waves. This reduces the frequency band that is necessary when sound absorbing materials are used frequently. This reduces the low-frequency response and noise that is difficult to pass through.In addition, in order to prevent the reflection and diffraction at the edge angle and the unevenness of the front baffle, the baffle surface is flattened except for the projection such as emblem and controller, and a large round of 40 mm is provided on both sides.In order to improve the overall sound quality when installed in a listening room, the speaker stand is designed with high rigidity and no resonance.It is made of a hard board that secures the same strength as D-77FX, and uses a single-leg structure that does not generate standing waves.In addition, you can fine-tune the height of the rear two of the four bottom points for flat and non-rattling settings even on slightly uneven floors."

name: D-77FXII
description: "A speaker system that further advanced the MID4 concept as an improved version of the D-77FX.To further promote the MID4 concept, both Woofer and Skoker cover a cutoff frequency of 2000 Hz, eliminating crossover from vocals and formant frequencies.Combining the advantages of a large-diameter woofer, which is advantageous for dynamic low-range playback, and a small-diameter squaker, which is advantageous for cross directivity, it realizes powerful vocal playback and crisp low-range playback.For the low range, a 27 cm cone-shaped woofer with a bicycloscone diaphragm is used.Biochloroscone is a mixture of wood pulp produced in high latitudes near the Arctic and refined cellulose, which is highly crystalline among natural cellulose. By integrating these two types of cellulose to form a paper layer network, physical properties with a balance of rigidity and confidentiality are obtained.The middle area uses a 16 cm cone type squaker made of the same bio black cone as the woofer.For the high-frequency band, we adopted the SH horn tweeter developed by taking advantage of the know-how of the Super Hypervolic Horn (SH (SH Horn) developed in the Ground Receptor GS-1.The change in Horn cross section is determined by hyperbolic function, and the change in shape is determined by superelliptic function including oblate function and shape function, by solving these simultaneous equations.We have also taken thorough measures to eliminate multipath ghost distortion, which is a problem in horn sound quality, from the aspects of horn shape and structure.In addition, Onkyo has developed its own technology for mass production of horns, such as the ultra-precision press method that improves the accuracy of the height and shape of the diaphragm, and the manufacturing process that uses the slide type pole piece to achieve matching between a narrow gap, ultra-precision driver section and an SH horn with a cutoff frequency of 1000 Hz, thus realizing the high transient and power linearity inherent in horns.The diaphragm is made of aluminum and magnesium alloy, which is lightweight and has a high internal loss, in order to obtain more natural sound quality.M.D. C.T. (Magnetic Distortion Cancel Technology) has been introduced, and the Skoker and Tweeter are equipped with copper rings, while the Woofer is equipped with aluminum rings to reduce harmonic distortion.Also, a new and large magnetic circuit is used.In addition, a canceling magnet is used to suppress magnetic flux leakage and prevent magnetic field effects on the choke coil in the network. At the same time, the canceling magnet prevents interference with the cathode ray tube during layout.The network is designed with attention paid to the smooth connection of units at the same time. The circuit board for each unit is divided, and all parts that need to be divided including circuits and parts are divided, so that the network has no mutual interference and little distortion.The enclosure employs an acoustic wave regulator composed of a slit and a chamber as a standing wave countermeasure, and the use of sound absorbing material is minimized so as not to affect other necessary frequency ranges.In addition, specially selected high-density particleboards are used to reduce vibration of the enclosure, and mechanical strength is increased by reinforcing the angle block, the center of the front baffle and the top plate.In order to improve the sound quality when installed in the listening room, the special speaker stand (sold separately) is also designed with high rigidity and no resonance. It uses a single-leg structure that does not generate standing waves and is made of hard particle board with the same strength as the D-77FXII body.You can also fine-tune the height of the two rear points out of the four front points for flat and steady settings on uneven floors."

name: D-77RX
description: "This speaker system was created based on the development concept of ""powerful and emotional vocals"" which wants to reproduce at the same time the strong sense of scale inherent in 3 ways and the depth of musical expression that gently speaks.In order to prevent phase rotation due to crossover in the important band of music, both Woofer and midrange are covered up to the cutoff frequency of 2300 Hz, eliminating the fundamental sound of vocals and formant frequency crossover.A 30 cm bio black cone unit is used for the low range.In addition, it uses a direct wiring method that sends music signals directly to the unit.To cover 4 octaves from 120 Hz to 2000 Hz in the middle range, it is equipped with a proven 16 cm aperture unit.In order to match the low-frequency range, a lightweight Bio-Croscone diaphragm is used. This diaphragm satisfies the requirements of light weight, high rigidity, high internal loss, and high airtightness by producing and mixing ascidian cellulose, which has the highest crystallinity among natural cellulose, with wood pulp produced in the high latitude region near the Arctic.The adoption of the short voice coil, which further advanced the concept of MDCT, was designed by increasing the size of the magnetic circuit so that the voice coil can always be oscillated in a uniform magnetic flux density. Compared to the general long voice coil, the voice coil has less distortion, and the differential operates under a constant electromagnetic brake, thus realizing sound with less distortion and high resolution.A 2.5 cm dome type unit is adopted for the high-frequency band.The diaphragm is made of an aluminum-magnesium alloy in which the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin are integrated, and has succeeded in reducing the weight by approximately 25% compared with the conventional tweeter.In addition, by using copper short ring, which is also an MDCT technology, the impedance rise at high frequencies, which is harmful to sound quality caused by AC magnetic flux, is suppressed. It is compatible with high-sampling digital sources, and reproduction is possible up to 40 kHz.For the network, we have succeeded in simple circuit configuration such as direct wiring of woofer to eliminate mounting reciprocal induction by dividing parts by band of each unit, and to avoid phase distortion caused by using complicated network circuit.A high-density particle board is used for the enclosure, and the structural strength is increased by soundbars and reinforcement materials to suppress unnecessary vibration.In addition, the front baffle is made of high-altitude, high-quality softwood medium density fiberboard.In addition, consideration is given to minimizing the use of sound absorbing material so as not to affect the necessary frequency range which influences the tone color.The terminal section has a banana plug compatible gold-plated brass scraping terminal.It is installed directly on the back plate, looking for a place with high strength and less susceptible to vibration.A special speaker stand is sold separately.This stand uses hard-textured, crisp softwood MDF to enhance overall sound quality.In addition, it has a structure that eliminates standing waves generated by vibrations at the bottom of the speaker."

name: D-77MRX
description: "A speaker system developed with Premium Technology introduced everywhere to realize ""improvement of dynamic S/N"".A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses a silk OMF (ONKYO Micro Fiber) diaphragm. This material was developed to be an ideal material that is lightweight, highly rigid and has high internal loss. It uses a matrix structure made of silk fiber and thermosetting resin. This reduces the inherent noise generated from the diaphragm itself, and the shape has been continuously improved to further expand the dynamic range and reduce distortion.In addition, damper material with less natural resonance is used.Equipped with 12 cm cone type skoker in the middle area.The diaphragm is equipped with silk OMF diaphragm as well as woofer.A 2.5 cm compound tweeter is installed in the high range.The vibration plate is a combination of 2.5 cm aluminum magnesium alloy dome and 4 cm bicycloscone.The newly developed S line edge is used for the edge part of the unit.In conventional edge design, the absorption of propagating waves and the superiority of the amplitude linearity of the diaphragm were emphasized. However, the reflection due to the mismatch of mechanical impedance at the junction with the diaphragm caused the loss of spatial information. We determined that the cause was the shape of the edge, and repeated data analysis and hearing to realize the shape with the least reflection of propagating waves.MDCT (magnetic distortion reduction technology) is adopted for the magnetic circuit.The speaker unit converts electrical signals into audio signals in accordance with Fleming's Law. However, in the conversion process, distortion is generated due to complex mutual interference of magnetic fields. To solve this problem, we are pursuing technology to prevent interference of DC / AC magnetic fields by improving the symmetry of magnetic flux, and we are reducing various types of distortion called non-linear distortion, magnetic distortion, and current distortion.The S. G. L. (Steady Ground Level) type isolated wiring network is used for the network part.This system uses an independent board for each unit to enable separate layout and eliminate electromagnetic interference. In addition, an S. G. L. type one point concentrated circuit is used for the ground, which is the reference of audio signals, to prevent current from flowing in the ground line and to enable more realistic reproduction with a constant ground potential.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.MDF is used for the entire surface, and 42 mm thickness is secured for the front baffle which especially requires strength. In addition, a dedicated wooden back chamber is incorporated in the back of the skoker to form an independent space, eliminating mutual interference between units due to pressure changes in the enclosure.The speaker terminal uses a gold-plated brass scraping terminal that supports banana plugs.There was a speaker stand as an option sold separately.This stand has rivets on the bottom to prevent vibration interference between the speaker stand and the floor.(If this rivet is used, scratches or marks may remain on the floor surface.)"

name: D-605F
description: "A speaker system that uses Onkyo's original technique to thoroughly reduce noise from all the parts that make up the speaker.Two 16 cm cone type woofers with silk OMF diaphragms are installed in the low range, and the twin drive system expands the low range playback range.The silk OMF diaphragm has a matrix structure made of silk fiber and thermosetting resin, and is characterized by low resonance sound inherent to the material. By using this diaphragm as a small-diameter unit, the response is enhanced.In addition, the edge and damper that support the diaphragm are carefully selected from materials with little inherent noise, and the shape that responds well to small signals and does not give a sense of clipping even when Tsutomu Dainyu is in use is selected.In addition, in order to solve the problem that the sound information is lost due to the reflection of the propagation wave generated at the diaphragm and edge junction, the S-line edge with the least reflection is adopted.A 2.5 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of lightweight polyester mesh and laminated with high-damping special urethane elastomer film to create a natural sound field.In addition, the N. R. I. C. (Non Reflective Inner Construction) structure is adopted to prevent the sound emitted from the rear of the diaphragm from being repeatedly reflected in the back chamber (rear vacant room) and degrading the sound quality, thereby increasing the purity of the sound.In the network section, the boards are separated and laid out separately for each sound range of each unit to prevent mutual interference due to electromagnetic induction. In addition, an S. G. L. (Steady Ground Level) 1-point concentrated circuit is used as the ground for audio signals to ensure a ground potential that does not easily fluctuate and improve reproducibility.In addition, by wrapping damping cloth around the internal wiring material, it is difficult to be affected by sound pressure and vibration of the enclosure, and high purity signal transmission is possible.The enclosure uses MDF and is finished with a real wood veneer.In addition, four horizontal reinforcing plates divide the vertical direction of the cabinet into five sections, increasing the rigidity of the long span baffle plates and side plates, and dispersing resonance frequencies so that sharp resonance does not occur at characteristic frequencies.The speaker terminal is made from gold-plated brass and is compatible with banana plugs and with a 6 mm diameter hole to accommodate very thick cables.In addition, to avoid the effect of vibration, we have adopted a mounting method in which it is fixed to a strong back plate."

name: D-908E
description: "The Tollboy type speaker system was developed by gathering together the speaker technology that Onkyo currently possesses.The unit is a further flash-up version of the D-312E mounted unit that was evaluated in the European magazine ""Revue du son"".A 16 cm cone type woofer by A-OMF Monocoque cone is mounted in the low range.The A-OMF Monocoque cone has a 4-layer structure made of PEN fiber, aramid fiber, cotton, and aramid fiber. In addition, the twill structure of PEN fiber has succeeded in eliminating the resin between fibers, improving the rigidity and internal loss of the diaphragm. In addition, the center cap and diaphragm are integrally molded into a bowl-shaped body with no inflection point to further increase the rigidity and completely eliminate the cause of divided vibration.The magnetic circuit is equipped with a 65 mm diameter voice coil and a large ferrite magnet of 1090g weight / 140 mm diameter to improve input resistance and sound quality.In addition, by adopting an aluminum die-cast frame with an average thickness of approximately 6 mm and an artificial leather edge made of ultra-fine fibers with consideration for responsiveness and reduction of unwanted sound reflection, consideration is also given to noise removal down to the minute level.A ring type tweeter using a ring type diaphragm with an outer diameter of 40 mm / inner diameter of 30 mm is mounted in the high range.The ring diaphragm is driven by a 35 mm diameter voice coil arranged on the same axis. By using the circumference corresponding to the middle point between the outer edge and the inner edge of the diaphragm as the driving point, the split vibration of the diaphragm is completely suppressed, and clear high-frequency reproduction in which the piston motion region reaches almost 20 kHz is realized. The inside of the diaphragm is equipped with a newly designed shaved aluminum equalizer, and by its unique shape, the frequency characteristic is flatter than that of the ultra-high-frequency range.In addition, anti-reflection measures around the diaphragm and the use of a back chamber shape that does not generate flutter echo have been taken to thoroughly eliminate noise.The network circuit uses an isolated wiring method to separate the woofer and tweeter network circuits to prevent interference between the signals of each band. In addition, a circuit mounting technology that does not generate a potential difference in the ground line of each network is introduced to prevent masking of minute audio signals.The capacitor is manufactured by WIMA in Germany.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system, and the bass reflex duct uses an advanced Aero Acoustic Drive, a slit-type duct with unique technology.This method not only attenuates unnecessary high-order noise components by adopting a long and narrow rectangular cross-section, but also achieves high-speed low-frequency playback because it is advantageous in terms of viscous resistance of the air. In addition, the enclosure and duct sections are separated from each other to minimize the effects of vibration.The enclosure structure is designed to increase vertical strength by rounding the sides. In addition, by placing power wood in the appropriate position of thick material such as 30 mm thick baffle, sound trapping due to unnecessary resonance is eliminated.The exterior is elaborately plated with silver heart material compared to the past.The speaker terminal is bi-wired to take advantage of the isolated wiring network circuit by reducing the mutual interference between woofer and tweeter.The terminal uses a brass machined gold plated terminal corresponding to a banana plug, and a short bar is attached.Spikes and spike receivers are included, and by attaching the spikes, unnecessary resonance from the floor surface can be prevented."

name: SCEPTER2002
description: "A 2-way floor type speaker system developed based on the know-how cultivated in the Scepter series speakers and the new theory proposed in the Grand Scepter GS-1.A 28 cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.Corn paper is made from wood pulp produced in high latitudes near the Arctic Circle, refined and mixed with ascidian cellulose, which is the most highly crystallized of natural cellulose. The integration of these two types of cellulose forms a network of dense paper layers, improving rigidity and airtightness.In addition, by adopting a large diameter voice coil of 7.6 cm, the distance to the edge is shortened, and low sound with excellent transient is realized.The magnetic circuit uses a large magnet and a copper cap to reduce harmonic distortion.The high-frequency range uses a super hyperbolic horn with a cut-off frequency of 500 Hz.The super hyperbolic horn is a technology developed at the time of the development of the GS-1. It adopts the hyperbolic function for the change in cross-sectional area and the super elliptic function including the oblate function and the shape function for the change in shape. By solving these simultaneous equations, the horn has a smooth extension without sudden shape change.This reduces the phenomenon called ""multipath ghost distortion"" in which high frequencies are reflected inside the horn due to stays, separators, steps, and irregularities inside the horn.In addition, in order to prevent a phenomenon called ""Reverb distortion"" in which unnecessary sound components are generated by vibration of the horn itself, approximately 2g/cm is added to the material of the horn.3By using resin concrete with a specific gravity of approximately 12 kg, the strain is reduced.The driver's 3.5 cm diaphragm uses reinforced A1-Mg alloy and is made by integral molding with the tangential edge which has excellent symmetry of amplitude.This diaphragm has been stabilized to prevent the original physical properties of the material from changing due to the stress applied to the metal during molding, so that the characteristics before molding are not lost.In the network, the filters for the woofer and the filters for the tweeter are built into each unit and are completely separated.In addition, in the network, all parts that need to be separated into circuits and parts are divided to form an isolated wiring network with little distortion and no mutual interference.One problem with horn-type speakers is that because the horn diaphragm is positioned behind the woofer by the length of the horn, there is a gap in the time it takes to reach the listener's ear.This appears as a disturbance in the characteristics near the crossover frequency. The time axis control circuit eliminates this disturbance and smooths the connection between units.The high-range and low-range sections have independent filters, enabling bi-amplifier and bi-wiring connections.In order to reduce unnecessary strain components (Reverb strain) generated by the vibration of the enclosure itself, the cabinet is not only reinforced in an invisible manner, but also actively employs a ""constrained damping method"" using damping materials and steel plates to reduce vibration.An acoustic wave regulator is also installed to absorb standing waves inside the enclosure.For vertical standing waves, a slit chamber at the bottom of the speaker is used as a wave regulator, and the section seen from the top of the cabinet is shaped like a ladder to prevent horizontal standing waves from occurring.The net of the woofer is detachable."

name: SCEPTERSC-2
description: "Based on the know-how accumulated through research, development and production of speakers, the Quest Series speaker system is based on Onkyo's concept of ""enjoying music with truly good sound"".The magnetic circuit uses MDCT (Magnetic Distortion Cancel Technology). The new shape and structure of the magnetic circuit enhances the symmetry of magnetic flux and successfully prevents the interference of direct and alternating magnetic fields.In addition, the MID4 concept has been introduced to achieve more natural sound quality by not allowing crossover in the frequency band between 125 Hz and 2000 Hz.For the low range, 18 cm cone type woofer is used.The Woofer diaphragm is made of Bio-Croscone, a blend of ascidian cellulose derived from biotechnology. In order to bring out the performance of this diaphragm, a newly designed magnetic circuit using MDCT is adopted to reduce current distortion and improve the rise response characteristics of the diaphragm.In addition, the newly adopted brass machined pole phase equalizer realizes a smooth middle and high frequency range without the effect of the shape of the diaphragm and the ""hollow effect"" or ""cavity resonance"" caused by the voice coil bobbin, and efficiently radiates heat generated in the voice coil.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is used for the high range.An even lighter aluminum-magnesium alloy has been developed for the diaphragm, and we have succeeded in reducing the weight by 25% compared with conventional products.In addition, a copper short ring is used for the magnetic circuit to reduce distortion.The enclosure distributes standing waves generated within it by means of tapered side walls and internal soundbars.In addition, an isolated mount system has been introduced. In order to prevent the reaction vibration of the diaphragm moved by the music signal from being transmitted from the magnetic circuit through the frame to the baffle plate and adversely affecting it, a slit is provided between the units to suppress the vibration transmitted through the baffle plate.In addition, an acoustic stabilizer is directly connected to the magnetic circuit of the woofer to absorb unwanted vibrations of the unit itself and vibrations caused by the reaction of the woofer diaphragm.It uses a gold plated terminal for banana plug which can be connected by bi-wiring.The special stand sold separately has a veneer finish with walnut single material (solid wood) at both ends of the base part.The top plate is a ""restraint damping structure"" with a 3 mm thick steel plate sandwiched with damping material to suppress unnecessary noise. In addition, two 50 mm square steel pipes are sandwiched between side plates (thrust plate finish) from both sides of the support part to suppress the swing of the support part.In addition, 4 round rivets can be attached to the back side of the base, and the back 2 of them are adjustable in height."

name: D-605C
description: "This is a center speaker that uses Onkyo's unique method of thoroughly reducing noise from all parts that compose the speaker.Two 13-cm cone woofers with silk OMF diaphragms are installed in the low range, and the twin drive system expands the low range playback range.The silk OMF diaphragm has a matrix structure made of silk fiber and thermosetting resin, and is characterized by low resonance sound inherent to the material. By using this diaphragm as a small-diameter unit, the response is enhanced.In addition, the edge and damper that support the diaphragm are carefully selected from materials with little inherent noise, and the shape that responds well to small signals and does not give a sense of clipping even when Tsutomu Dainyu is in use is selected.In addition, in order to solve the problem that the sound information is lost due to the reflection of the propagation wave generated at the diaphragm and edge junction, the S-line edge with the least reflection is adopted.A 2.5 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of lightweight polyester mesh and laminated with high-damping special urethane elastomer film to create a natural sound field.In addition, the N. R. I. C. (Non Reflective Inner Construction) structure is adopted to prevent the sound emitted from the rear of the diaphragm from being repeatedly reflected in the back chamber (rear vacant room) and degrading the sound quality, thereby increasing the purity of the sound.In the network section, the boards are separated and laid out separately for each sound range of each unit to prevent mutual interference due to electromagnetic induction. In addition, an S. G. L. (Steady Ground Level) 1-point concentrated circuit is used as the ground for audio signals to ensure a ground potential that does not easily fluctuate and improve reproducibility.In addition, by wrapping damping cloth around the internal wiring material, it is difficult to be affected by sound pressure and vibration of the enclosure, and high purity signal transmission is possible.The enclosure uses MDF and is finished with a real wood veneer.The speaker terminal is made from gold-plated brass and is compatible with banana plugs and with a 6 mm diameter hole to accommodate very thick cables.In addition, to avoid the effect of vibration, we have adopted a mounting method in which it is fixed to a strong back plate."

description: "An active super-woofer system with excellent space factor and tuned to match any type of speaker.The unit uses a cone-shaped woofer with a 1 mm thick delta-olefin reinforced diaphragm.A thick diaphragm provides strength and confidentiality, and a maximum stroke of 33 mm is achieved by the engineering elastomer edge on the nerve with a raised part and double damper structure.The enclosure is a floor type with excellent space factor.The internal structure of this enclosure employs a newly developed tapered slit duct structure that continuously changes the effective length of the duct to prevent natural mechanical and acoustic vibrations, and is tuned to a special unit.In the SL-10, a large slit duct with an equivalent diameter of 10 cm is installed on the bottom and the reproduced sound is radiated from the opening at the lower front. name: SL-D1000
description: "The newly developed A-OMF Monocoque cone and digital amplifier VL Digital are flagship sub-woofers developed by gathering the best technologies that Onkyo can have now.The unit is equipped with a newly developed 30cmA-OMF monocoque woofer.The A-OMF Monocoque uses a multi-layer structure of PEN fiber, cotton, and aramid fiber. Furthermore, by making the PEN fiber into a twill structure, we succeeded in eliminating resins between fibers, thereby improving the rigidity and internal loss of the diaphragm.In addition, the center cap and diaphragm are integrally molded to form a bowl-shaped structure with no inflection point, further increasing rigidity and completely eliminating the factor of split vibration.In order to drive this diaphragm faithfully, we use a large voice coil with a diameter of 100 mm, an anodized aluminum voice coil bobbin with improved heat resistance and transmission characteristics, and a neodymium magnet with high magnetic flux density, consisting of 16 magnets with diameters of 24mmx6mm.In addition, by installing double dampers, it is designed to firmly support the diaphragm even at large amplitude.In order to firmly support the structure of the weight class, an aluminum die-cast frame is adopted for the frame, and unnecessary resonance from the frame itself is suppressed by not having a refracting surface. In addition, by keeping the magnetic circuit inside the frame and firmly holding it, unnecessary shake of the whole unit is suppressed.The power amplifier uses a PWM (pulse width modulation) method for A/D modulation with less noise outside the audible band, and uses a VL Digital digital amplifier originally developed for pure audio.The VL Digital is an integral-type modulation circuit with two circuits consisting of a vector generator, an integrator, and an inversion trigger generator. Therefore, even if spike noise, which is the cause of conversion error, enters from the outside, the spike noise itself has a symmetrical waveform in the upper and lower sides, so the energy of the upper and lower waveforms cancel each other out, enabling error-free A/D conversion.This amplifier realizes an instantaneous current supply capability (HICC) of 100A, which is an indication of speaker drive capability.In place of the circular duct, which easily emits standing waves inside the cabinet and easily generates strong standing waves from the duct itself, we have adopted the advanced AERO ACOUSTIC DRIVE, a slit-type duct developed by our own technology.By adopting a thin rectangular cross section, not only can unnecessary high-order noise components be attenuated, but it is also advantageous in viscous resistance of the air, making it possible to reproduce low sound with a sense of speed.In addition, by separating the cabinet and duct, the effect of mutual vibration is suppressed, and reproducibility at the minute level is improved.It is equipped with functions such as auto standby function, 12 v trigger capable of interlocking power supply with external equipment, phase selection switch, 4-stage switchable high-cut filter, switchable filter, etc."

name: TORINOST-3
description: "This is a 3D (three dimensional) speaker system based on the new idea of making the satellite unit as small as possible and bringing it closer to the point sound source while allowing only one woofer unit to receive the low sound range.An 8 cm cone type speaker is used for the satellite unit.A compact and lightweight short voice coil is used to reduce the size and weight of the voice coil. name: INTEGRAP-306RS
description: "Control amplifier using super turbo system.Newly developed super turbo system is adopted.This system combines a delta turbo circuit and a turbo filter circuit to suppress the modulation noise caused by the power transformer, expand the dynamic dynamic range by more than 20 dB, cut the harmonic noise caused by the flux generated by the transformer, and eliminate various electrical noise entering from the outside of the amplifier.The delta turbo circuit is designed to prevent modulation noise caused by + - imbalance in the power supply when a low frequency signal of 100 Hz or less is input.In the conventional power supply, only the positive and negative sides of the B power supply Chemi-Con and transformer windings, which supply power depending on whether the waveform of the signal flowing into the speaker is positive or negative, worked separately. Especially when the audio signal is 100 Hz or less, the power supply on one side, for example, the Chemi-Con on the negative side is off while the Chemi-Con on the positive side is being charged, and the charging current returns to the transformer through the midpoint. In the delta turbo circuit, the diode is turned off while the amplitude of the audio signal is small. Therefore, even while the positive side is being charged, the power supply flows into the Chemi-Con on the negative side without passing through the midpoint. As a result, the Chemi-Con on the negative side is charged up. Even if the voltage on the positive side drops due to the supply of power to the speaker, the voltage on the negative side rises reversely and the voltage fluctuation with respect to the voltage across the transformer is relatively small. This reduces the amplitude modulation of the charging current and suppresses the generation of modulation noise.In addition, in this circuit, the diodes are delta-connected, so that the modulation noise does not flow only to the ground point of the circuit, even if the diode is turned on during high-power operation.The turbo filter circuit is designed to prevent the modulation noise generated by the magnitude of the signal regardless of the frequency of the signal. The function of the circuit is to limit the harmonic spectrum generated by the pulse waveform supplied from the power transformer to only the amount necessary for the Chemi-Con charging.There are two types of modulation noise generated by the harmonic spectrum. One type flows into the amplifier through the power supply line, and the other type flows out into the amplifier as magnetic flux from the power transformer. Especially in the micro-level amplification system in the amplifier, the noise voltage induced by this flux is generated, and it stains the original music signal. Furthermore, since this flux varies in proportion to the signal magnitude, it appears as signal information in the sense of hearing, and it has been considered to be the limit of the resolution of reproduced sound. In the turbo filter circuit, the modulation noise component is suppressed according to the turbo filter optimum attenuation characteristics, and the necessary charging energy is sent to the Chemicon.This turbo filter circuit has a special CR filter placed in the power transformer. The inductance of this CR and transformer constitutes an equivalent circuit filter as shown below.Another function of the turbo filter is to suppress modulation noise and prevent various types of noise from the external AC power supply from entering the power supply section, thereby reducing the difference in sound quality depending on the polarity of the AC power supply.Super Servo Integral System is adopted.This system focuses on sound quality problems caused by external factors such as the sound pressure directly received from the speaker and compatibility with the power amplifier. The system employs a super stabilizer, an output capacitor-less system, and a super servo cord to solve electrical and mechanical problems.The super-stabilizer weighs about 3 kg and is reinforced as a chassis structure material, and vibration resistance is improved by weight. Furthermore, since each substrate is fixed to this stabilizer, vibration of the substrate itself is suppressed by the internal absorption effect.In addition, various circuit currents flow inside the amplifier, and the resulting space charge is distributed in a complex manner on the insulator. These charges adversely affect the signal circuit during reconnection. The super stabilizer is made of a conductive layer made of special carbon particles, and space charge is equalized and partial reconnection is reduced, so that a higher purity sound can be obtained.A common preamplifier has an output capacitor at the output end. However, the low frequency band was cut by the capacitor itself and the RC circuit using the input impedance and the output capacitor when connected to a power amplifier. This was a major problem especially when connected to a power amplifier with low input impedance or when multiple power amplifiers were driven in parallel.In the Super Servo Integral system, since the output capacitor is eliminated, the low-frequency time constant is determined only by the servo circuit. Therefore, flat low-frequency characteristics can be obtained even when driving with a low impedance load, and at the same time, excellent distortion characteristics are realized.By using the supplied super servo cord, the problem caused by the cable between the pre-power and the power is solved.The positive input terminal of the output amplifier detects and suppresses harmful ultra-low frequency components that cause intermodulation distortion. The negative servo amplifier cancels components caused by the resistance of the connection between the P-306RS and the cable, the resistance of the cable itself, and the inductance of the cable itself, thereby preventing interference between channels and degradation of separation.In addition, in order to eliminate the influence of diode characteristics due to contact at the pin plug part, a DC bias for idling is superimposed on the ground line to suppress non-linear characteristics and reduce IM.The servo circuit operates when the ground line is connected, and its operation can be confirmed by the Connection lamp. The effect of this servo code can be effectively combined with any general power amplifier.The equalizer amplifier has a simple one stage configuration that can handle MM to MC types. In the differential amplifier section at the front stage, two ultra-low-noise High Gm FETs are thermally coupled in a special metal case to improve thermal balance and suppress extraneous noise components. In addition, the differential section is para-connected in order to improve the overall S/N ratio by reducing the impedance of the signal system. In addition, in order to obtain wider frequency characteristics, the differential section is leased by cord connection to suppress the mirror feedback capacitance.The second stage differential amplifier and the third stage differential amplifier with current mirror ensure large bare gain, and the partial feedback by skillful pole setting realizes high gain, excellent stability and low distortion factor.The final stage is an A-class push-pull circuit, which smoothly transmits signals to the next stage amplifier at a low distortion rate even under heavy load in the high frequency range.In addition to suppressing the interference between the left and right channels, the entire power supply system is designed to be low impedance to prevent the interference caused by the power supply between the front and rear stages, thereby suppressing the occurrence of dynamic modulation.A high-speed response NF type constant voltage stabilizing circuit is used, and each circuit block is directly connected by a bus line to suppress distortion caused by interference.Onkyo's unique direct tone method is used for tone control.In this system, no tone amplifier is used and only passive elements are used to simplify the circuit. In addition, no capacitor is used in the signal circuit, which is problematic in sound quality.Equipped with a cartridge selector for the MC cartridge to maximize the performance of the cartridge. (10 ~ 40 ¥, 3 ~ 10 �)Uses a selector with a CD position.Output can be directly input in the CD position.The recording selector is only required for recording. By feeding the source to the REC pin terminal, the effect on sound quality is minimized.By adopting a mechanical structure using non-magnetic parts, the effect of harmful high-order harmonics is eliminated.High-performance special sound quality improvement type resistor is adopted."

description: "This is a control amplifier that is designed for full-scale digital applications, with a focus on simplification and high-purity transmission.The Direct In / Direct Out concept is thoroughly implemented and a multi-functional yet simple circuit configuration is adopted.Line-type inputs such as CD inputs are selected with the Input Selector switch and sent directly to the master volume-flat amplifier without passing through muting, balance volume, mode, etc.The tone control employs a direct tone system that uses only passive elements and part of a volume circuit, eliminating the need for tone amplifiers.In addition, both the input side and the output side are connected by direct connection with the shortest distance.Equipped with 8 input selectors and an independent double REC selector for Tape1 only and Tape2 & 3.There are two outputs, each with a MODE switch, so you can get output for 3D subwoofer or center channel playback.The Output2 is equipped with independent output attenuators on the left and right sides for simultaneous use of balance volume.The circuit configuration is a super servo amplifier with twin FET input stage and twin push-pull output stage connected directly to the input. As a material that can obtain a constant voltage of about 2 v with relatively small current, excellent characteristics are achieved by applying LED bias, which is advantageous in terms of temperature coefficient and noise generation.In order to handle very small input signals, the equalizer amplifier has a double-twin-FET configuration with a thermal stabilizer for the input stage to further reduce noise.The power supply section uses a satellite power supply for low impedance power supply, and also uses separate windings for each amplifier for exclusive block power supply to eliminate mutual interference.To eliminate noise from the power supply, a noise separator is installed between the primary and secondary sides of the power transformer to prevent common-mode noise from entering from the primary side. Normal-mode noise is eliminated by a charge noise filter.In addition, the power transformer, charge noise filter, and rectifying / smoothing block are separated from the amplifier circuit and covered with a shield case. Only the DC line is taken out to supply power to the constant voltage circuit, eliminating electromagnetic interference from the power supply.A signal-in-phase transformer is used on both input and output sides to eliminate common-mode noise from external sources and to improve separation by eliminating interference between L and R caused by ground lines of pin cords connecting devices.It uses a direct tone control circuit with a contrabus.Equipped with cartridge selector of MC2 position and MM2 position."

name: INTEGRAP-309
description: "A stereo preamplifier developed as the culmination of the ""W Ï‰ Super Servo System"" which is a further development of the ""Super Servo System"".Taking advantage of the characteristics of the super servo system originally developed by Onkyo, the gain of the equalizer amplifier is increased so that it can be used for all cartridges from MM type to MC type without using a head amplifier or step amplifier transformer.The three units of the MC head amplifier, equalizer and buffer are combined into a single stage type simple equalizer amplifier. It uses a high-current A-class amplifier comparable to a 5W-class output power amplifier, and realizes NF / CR division type equalization in one stage without a buffer amplifier.In the first stage differential amplifier section, two ultra-low noise and high Gm FETs are thermally coupled in an aluminum case to improve thermal balance and suppress external thermal noise. In addition, S/N is improved by connecting the differential section in parallel to lower impedance. In order to suppress mirror feedback capacitance, this differential amplifier is connected in cascode to expand frequency characteristics.The second stage differential amplifier and the third stage differential amplifier with current mirror ensure a large naked gain, and by using partial feedback by skillful pole setting, stability and constant distortion factor are realized.A waiting monitor is mounted on the panel surface.This monitor detects the temperature of the A-class push-pull transistor at the final stage of the equalizer and the transistor used for the power supply of the equalizer, and displays the stability of the bias after the power is turned on and the operational status of the amplifier with 5-level indicators.In order to prevent the inductance and resistance of the extension cord, contact resistance at the connection part, crosstalk, etc., W super servo system is adopted.The W Ï‰ Super Servo system suppresses cross modulation due to unnecessary ultra-low frequencies and equivalently cancels harmful noise components caused by the impedance between the earth and the ground. By using the attached servo sensor code, the distance between the pre-power and the power is electrically reduced to 0 to cancel harmful components.Direct Tone is a unique tone control method that does not affect the sound quality.Since it is composed of only passive elements and does not allow harmful capacitors to enter the signal passage path, it can freely correct sound fields without affecting sound quality.When a power amplifier with low input impedance is connected or when multiple power amplifiers are driven in parallel, problems such as shortage of extremely low frequencies tend to occur. However, by adopting the super servo system, there is no need to insert a capacitor in the output section, and the low-frequency time constant is determined only by the servo circuit, so that shortage of low frequencies is prevented regardless of the load.As for the power supply, the right and left channels are supplied with completely independent power supplies, and even within the same channel, in order to prevent interference through the power supplies at the front and rear stages, the entire power supply system is designed to be low impedance, and the generation of dynamic modulation (transient intermodulation distortion) is suppressed.In the IntegraP 309, independent NF type constant voltage stabilizing circuits are used for the left and right sides, and each circuit block is directly connected by a thick copper plate bus (bus) line.Equipped with a cartridge selector, the optimum load impedance can be switched according to the cartridge to be used.It is equipped with a recording selector so that the deck is not always connected to part of the circuit even when recording is not done.You can also record the tuner output while listening to the record.It has a built-in headphone amplifier so that you can use headphones.Various filters, muting and input selectors are stored in the kangaroo pocket.Non-magnetic materials such as copper, aluminum, and brass are used for all necessary parts including the shielding part and all other parts to suppress high-order harmonic distortion caused by magnetic flux.A self-illuminated one touch selector is used for input switching.In addition, a method of selecting by a small special audio relay is adopted, and there is no signal wiring.Equipped with a thermo-coupled register, a register with coupled thermal coefficients is used so that a delicate servo effect is always stably applied to the signal."

name: INTEGRAP-388
description: "Stereo preamplifier equipped with super balance circuit.It uses a double differential amplifier circuit that combines a flat amplifier circuit with Onkyo's original double differential amplifier circuit and double super servo. It is compatible with any balanced or unbalanced input and realizes direct and stable operation.In addition, in order to take advantage of the characteristics of the cartridge, an optimized equalizer circuit exclusively for MM/MC is adopted.By using dedicated input terminals and eliminating switching circuits, simple amplification with the minimum number of contacts is achieved.Direct Signal Flow Construction is used to simplify signal paths inside the chassis and to connect them at the shortest distance.The switching circuits for balanced and unbalanced inputs are made independent of each other, and the signal is sent to the microprocessor by the operation of the input selector for total control.In addition, the switching circuit for unbalanced input is placed near the input terminal, and the switching circuit for balanced input is placed just before the master volume to shorten the wiring.The master volume is placed on the flat amplifier input in the center of the chassis and is operated from the front panel via an extension shaft to minimize the distance of the low-level wiring.The power supply section employs a super-shunt power supply that combines a super-linear power supply and a shunt regulator, which are not affected by load fluctuations. The power supply circuit that supplies the MC equalizer amplifier, MM equalizer amplifier, flat amplifier (L), and flat amplifier (R) is mounted completely independently.This reduces AC infrastructure noise and reduces the influence on other circuits.The power transformer uses a LASER transformer with a modified core that reduces the magnetic resistance by increasing the width of the outer part. In addition, the core is carefully shielded with a silicon copper plate shield material to reduce the leakage flux to 1 / 30 compared to the conventional EI core transformer.In addition, 3 laser transformers for the flat amplifier, equalizer amplifier and control circuit are used completely independently to reduce the influence on the amplifier section that handles the signal and to eliminate interference between each stage.The layout is such that the digital control part housed in the front panel, the power supply part which supplies power to each stage, and the signal path are connected by the shortest distance.Furthermore, by adopting a 3 box structure in which each amplifier section is completely shielded, digital noise and power supply noise do not adversely affect each stage of the amplifier section.Both the volume and input selector employ a mechanical system driven by a motor. It can be controlled at hand using a remote control while suppressing the generation of non-linear distortion like semiconductor switches.Compared to conventional volumes, the master volume uses a custom-made 4-series volume made of carbon resistance with an ultra-low distortion rate of -40dB. It also uses film capacitors and other parts made by Raderstein of Germany, which was decided to use after repeated trial listening.The resistor uses parts such as a high-precision large carbon resistor (3/4W type), a 70-micron copper foil substrate, a balanced die-cast XLR type 3P connector, a gold-plated machined pin jack, an ultra-low impedance Chemicon for power supply, and an extra-thick cap-tire AC cord."

description: "In addition to further improving the transient response measures and dynamic characteristics of the equalizer circuit and tone circuit developed in the Integra Series, a fundamental study was also made on graining and sense of orientation in the middle and low frequency range to raise the quality of the preamplifier.A dual-channel system independent power supply is used to supply power to the left and right channels independently.This eliminates interchannel interference within the preamp and improves separation.The power supply section uses a feedback stabilized ¥2 power supply type constant voltage circuit with a fluctuation rate of 1.7%, so that the effect of power supply fluctuation does not appear in the circuit that performs delicate voltage amplification.For the equalizer amplifier circuit, the transient response characteristics are improved by using an operational amplifier type circuit with a single 4-chip configuration of differential 1-stage and final stage single, which was derived from detailed theoretical analysis of NF circuit.For the tone amplifier circuit, we have adopted an operational amplifier circuit with a differential 1-stage 3-chip configuration determined by circuit analysis using a computer. name: INTEGRAM-505
description: "DC power amplifier with improved dynamic modulation (transient intermodulation distortion).In order to improve dynamic modulation, D. L. C. (Dual Line Construction) direct-coupled power supply system is adopted to eliminate not only interference between left and right channels but also interference that occurs within the same channel.For the power supply and distribution lines of each circuit, a multi-spray Bussler in held at ultra-low impedance is adopted, and extremely thick power distribution wires (cross-sectional area 5.5 mm) are used.2On the other hand, in the NF block of each stage, each branch is directly connected to the bus hotline for each point, and power is supplied to each stage individually. In addition, a 1 mm thick bus ground line is also used for the ground line, and dynamic modulation is prevented by making these supply and distribution lines low impedance.The power supply unit is also designed to have low impedance. We have developed and used a high-capacity (18,000 Ï‰ Fx4) electrolytic capacitor that maintains low impedance up to 100 kHz. This capacitor was developed especially for audio applications. It has a distortion factor of -150dB at the third harmonic level at 10 kHz, an equivalent series resistance (E. S. R.) of 0.01 � or less, and a loss of tan � of 0.25 or less. It achieves low impedance.The D. L. C. system is used to reduce interference between the left and right channels by using a two channel D. L. C. system with a mono-amplifier that is independent of all circuits.The power transformer with a large laminated core maintains regulation of 160W + 160W at 4 � output, and the stored energy in the power supply reaches 148 joules.A new low-noise monolithic dual FET is used for the first stage differential amplifier to form a complete DC amplifier.This newly developed FET consists of two FETs on a single pellet. The temperature characteristics and other characteristics are almost exactly the same, and the temperature difference is small because the pellet is the same. This FET is an ideal device for a DC amplifier. As a result, the temperature drift is stable within ¥20 mv at ¥30 Ï‰ for a temperature of 20 ?. In addition, since this FET uses a ceramic base, it is more moisture-resistant than a conventional dual-in-line plastic package.The first stage FET differential amplifier is an active broad of a constant current circuit with good temperature characteristics. It is designed to have a good common-mode rejection ratio. In addition, the low input impedance of the cascade connected transistor prevents the degradation of high frequency characteristics due to the feedback capacitance mirror effect.In addition, impedance conversion is performed by placing an emitter follower next, and the frequency characteristic at the first stage is extended to 2 MHz.The power stage is a pure complimentary service circuit using an NPN-PNP transistor with the same characteristics. The 3-stage Darlington connection reduces the load on the current mirror circuit of the drive stage and reduces distortion. The final stage achieves low distortion by using a TO-3 transistor with sufficient power in parallel push-pull and using it in a region with good linearity.The drive stage employs a current mirror circuit using a high-voltage transistor with low junction capacitance and high fT. This reduces distortion and makes it less susceptible to power supply voltage fluctuations.A large aluminum die-cast heat sink is used for the heat radiation part.It is equipped with a protective circuit that electronically detects the output DC voltage and the power transistor overcurrent. If there is a problem, a relay disconnects the speaker. This circuit is also in standby mode when the power is turned on and can be seen by an indicator on the front panel.Since DC may come in from the input other than when the amplifier has failed, the DC detection section is independent on the left and right sides and operates even when the DC polarity is different on the left and right sides. The overcurrent detection circuit quickly disconnects the speaker when the load is short-circuited or when the impedance is low.The power transformer incorporates a high-precision temperature switch and a thermal fuse in each of the left and right sides. In the event of an abnormal temperature rise due to overload or failure, the power is turned off and the speaker relay is turned off. When the transformer cools down to normal temperature, they automatically recover and the thermal fuse does not blow during normal operation.The switch on the rear panel allows you to switch the lower cutoff frequency from DC to 0.15 Hz to 10 Hz.In the DC position, there is no capacitor in the signal path or NF loop from input to output, and it is a complete DC amplifier. In the 0.15 Hz position, it can be connected to a preamp with a DC leak, which cannot be connected to a DC amplifier. The coupling capacitor used for this is a low-distortion, low-loss special chemical capacitor selected by hearing with a particular emphasis on sound quality, so its performance in the audible band hardly changes.The 10 Hz position is used as a subsonic filter to prevent the cone paper from swaying during disc playback.Left and right independent level volume is mounted on the rear panel."

name: INTEGRAM-506
description: "A stereo power amplifier that adopts the W / Super Servo system.The W / Super Servo system is used to cancel the feedback of harmful components from both the + side and - side of the output terminal via the servo amplifier.The + side cancels the ultra-low frequency component that is superimposed on the music signal and flows into the speaker to suppress harmful intermodulation. The - side servo loop suppresses the electromotive force caused by the impedance between the input ground and the output ground side, the internal resistance of the power supply capacitor, the impedance of the lead wire, etc., and only the music signal is sent to the output terminal.By servocontrol both ends of the output side, the components of impurities, harmful noise and distortion that have masked the music signal are eliminated to improve the resolution.Output stage is 3-stage Darlington configuration, high-fTBy using a power transistor, an output with less distortion is achieved. In addition, the operating characteristic of the power transistor is Onkyo's unique linear switching method to further improve the distortion factor.This system was developed with the intention of taking advantage of the characteristics of A class while taking advantage of the advantages of B class, focusing on the fact that only the final output stage works as B class in amplifiers. It is a system with linear characteristics developed under the design policy that bias must be fixed. It is a high-f type system with linear characteristics.TIt demonstrates excellent performance when combined with a power transistor.As a result of research on the influence on sound quality, we have newly developed a large twin-winded transformer for the power supply section. As a result of careful listening and investigation of the correlation between material properties in consideration of its importance, we have used a multi-tab type low-impedance wide-range Chemi-Con as a low-inductance circuit directly connected to a printed circuit board.In addition, bus (bus) lines are used for the power supply / distribution to each section and the ground line, etc. to achieve a thorough low impedance.When there is a sudden change from a continuous large amplitude operation to a small amplitude operation, a thermal gradient occurs due to the difference in heat capacity between the final blocks. This sudden partial temperature change makes the bias current value of the power section unstable and affects the reproduction of a low-level signal in particular.As a countermeasure against this problem, the M-506 has a 3-point sensing bias circuit in the output stage, detects the temperature difference between the pre-driver, driver and power transistor, and controls the bias, ensuring stable low-distortion drive.The protection circuit uses a monolithic IC to improve stability. It also detects DC leakage voltage at the speaker terminals and overcurrent in the power stage. In the event of an emergency, it instantly shuts off the relay (silver contact, parallel use) to protect the circuit components.For speaker switching, the protection relay dedicated to SP-1 and SP-2 is switched to prevent degradation of the damping factor. Also, the low-pass filter for DC voltage detection is independent of LR so that it operates even when the polarity of the left and right is different.It employs a large peak meter that performs logarithmic compression and peak hold with a stable monolithic IC.In addition, to obtain high-speed response, it is driven by a dedicated drive circuit using an operational amplifier.The level can be changed from 0 dB to 120W or 12W with the front switch.From semiconductor devices and transformers, to resistors and capacitors, printed circuit boards, lead wires for wiring, to solder for fusion bonding, we have repeatedly conducted thorough examinations through interviews."

name: INTEGRAM-506R
description: "This is a Super Servo / Integral Stereo Power Amplifier that analyzes the amplifier not only as a single electric circuit but also including the acoustic aspect of the playback sound field, and thoroughly investigates the problem of time difference distortion.In addition to Onkyo's original W / Super Servo system, Super Servo Integral system is used to reduce the influence of the electromotive force of the speaker.When the voice coil of the speaker vibrates, an electromotive force is generated in the coil, a microphone effect, which affects the playback sound. The Super Servo Integral Method employs a circuit that reduces the effect of this electromotive force to -20dB or less. Positive and negative feedback is applied only to the current amplification stage by the linearity correction circuit, and the linearity of this stage is dramatically improved, and time difference distortion is suppressed.The final transistor operates using a linear switching method.Similar to class B operation, this method is amplified by two transistors. In this case, the linearity of the joint of the operation curve is corrected by a special bias circuit to obtain linear operation characteristics. As a result, crossover distortion is reduced, and characteristics close to class A operation can be obtained while maintaining the advantage of class B operation.And High fTBy using a power transistor, the switching distortion is suppressed to a negligible range.It is equipped with a large peak meter in which logarithmic compression and peak hold are performed by a monolithic IC with good stability and dispersion between right and left is suppressed.In order to obtain high-speed response, it is driven by a dedicated meter drive circuit using an operational amplifier, and the level can be switched from 0 dB to 130W or 13W with a front switch.A monolithic IC is used for the protection circuit to improve stability, detect DC leak voltage appearing at the speaker terminal and overcurrent of the power stage, and shut off the relay to protect circuit components in case of emergency.A highly reliable gold-plated silver contact relay is used for the speaker switching relay, and the use of para-connection prevents the damping factor from deteriorating.The low-pass filter for DC voltage detection is also independent on the left and right sides, so that it can operate even when the polarity of the left and right sides are different.A twin-wide type large power transformer is used for the power supply section, and a multi-tab type low-impedance wide-range Chemi-Con is used as a low-inductance circuit directly connected to a bus earth for the Chemi-Con for rectification after careful consideration.In addition, the power supply / distribution to each section and the ground line are designed to be low impedance.It uses an autotracking bias system that detects local temperature changes in each part and provides a stable bias supply."

name: INTEGRAM-506RS
description: "Stereo power amplifier using super turbo system.Newly developed super turbo system is adopted.This system combines a delta turbo circuit and a turbo filter circuit to suppress the modulation noise caused by the power transformer, expand the dynamic dynamic range by more than 20 dB, cut the harmonic noise caused by the flux generated by the transformer, and eliminate various electrical noise entering from the outside of the amplifier.The delta turbo circuit is designed to prevent modulation noise caused by + - imbalance in the power supply when a low frequency signal of 100 Hz or less is input.In the conventional power supply, only the positive and negative sides of the B power supply Chemi-Con and transformer windings, which supply power depending on whether the waveform of the signal flowing into the speaker is positive or negative, worked separately. Especially when the audio signal is 100 Hz or less, the power supply on one side, for example, the Chemi-Con on the negative side is off while the Chemi-Con on the positive side is being charged, and the charging current returns to the transformer through the midpoint. In the delta turbo circuit, the diode is turned off while the amplitude of the audio signal is small. Therefore, even while the positive side is being charged, the power supply flows into the Chemi-Con on the negative side without passing through the midpoint. As a result, the Chemi-Con on the negative side is charged up. Even if the voltage on the positive side drops due to the supply of power to the speaker, the voltage on the negative side rises reversely and the voltage fluctuation with respect to the voltage across the transformer is relatively small. This reduces the amplitude modulation of the charging current and suppresses the generation of modulation noise.In addition, in this circuit, the diodes are delta-connected, so that the modulation noise does not flow only to the ground point of the circuit, even if the diode is turned on during high-power operation.The turbo filter circuit is designed to prevent the modulation noise generated by the magnitude of the signal regardless of the frequency of the signal. The function of the circuit is to limit the harmonic spectrum generated by the pulse waveform supplied from the power transformer to only the amount necessary for the Chemi-Con charging.There are two types of modulation noise generated by the harmonic spectrum. One type flows into the amplifier through the power supply line, and the other type flows out into the amplifier as magnetic flux from the power transformer. Especially in the micro-level amplification system in the amplifier, the noise voltage induced by this flux is generated, and it stains the original music signal. Furthermore, since this flux varies in proportion to the signal magnitude, it appears as signal information in the sense of hearing, and it has been considered to be the limit of the resolution of reproduced sound. In the turbo filter circuit, the modulation noise component is suppressed according to the turbo filter optimum attenuation characteristics, and the necessary charging energy is sent to the Chemicon.This turbo filter circuit has a special CR filter placed in the power transformer. The inductance of this CR and transformer constitutes an equivalent circuit filter as shown below.Another function of the turbo filter is to suppress modulation noise and prevent various types of noise from the external AC power supply from entering the power supply section, thereby reducing the difference in sound quality depending on the polarity of the AC power supply.Super Servo Integral System is adopted.The microphone effect occurs when the voice coil of the speaker vibrates. This electromotive force is always generated as long as the coil vibrates in a magnetic field. It cannot be fundamentally cancelled. In addition, this electromotive force affects the playback sound when the input signal of the speaker collides with this electromotive force. Especially in stereo sound fields, the sound reproduced from the R channel travels through the air and reaches the L channel speaker. With this sound pressure, the diaphragm of the L channel speaker vibrates. Moreover, there is a time lag for the sound to propagate between the two speakers. When an electromotive force different from the input signal that is generated enters the power stage, if the linearity of the power stage is not good, time difference distortion occurs between the input signal of the L channel and the input signal of the power stage, and this has a large effect on the playback sound.In the Super Servo Integral Method, the generation of intermodulation distortion caused by this electromotive force is reduced to less than 1/10 (-20dB or more). The time difference distortion is not a problem as long as the linearity of the current amplification stage including the power stage is ensured. Therefore, in the conventional amplifier, NF is applied to correct the non-linear part of the current amplification stage, and the part which cannot be corrected by NF is corrected by the W super servo of the + side servo for ultra-low frequency and the - side servo for the ground line, so that it has some effect. In the Super Servo Integral Method, this idea is further advanced, the characteristics of the current amplification stage are greatly improved, and on top of that, the same correction as in the past is carried out to improve the time difference distortion.Specifically, we apply positive and negative feedback by a linearity correction circuit only to the current amplifier stage from the output stage outlet, and improve the linearity of this stage to suppress time difference distortion.Onkyo's original linear switching system is adopted.The linear switching method is a B-class circuit with a fixed bias, but it was developed with the aim of being equal to the A-class circuit in terms of sound quality. It has a simple circuit configuration using simple circuit elements, but the crossover distortion is kept low and there is no change in sound quality due to bias fluctuations.In addition, the use of high-fT power transistors keeps switching distortion within a negligible range.Two large twin-winded power transformers are used for the power supply section, and a multi-tab type low-impedance, wide-range condenser is used as a low-inductance circuit directly connected to a bus earth for the rectifier capacitor.In addition, the power supply / distribution lines and ground lines of each section are designed to have low impedance.Equipped with a large peak meter.Logarithmic compression and peak hold are performed by a monolithic IC with good stability, and there is almost no variation in left / right indication. In addition, to obtain high-speed response, it is driven by a dedicated meter drive circuit using an operational amplifier.The level can be changed from 0 dB to 140W or 14W with the front switch.Equipped with an auto-tracking bias system to ensure stable operation.When there is a sudden change from a continuous large amplitude operation to a small amplitude operation with a music signal, the thermal gradient occurs due to the difference in heat capacity between the final blocks. In the case of a gradual temperature change, each part is affected in the same way, so there is no problem. However, in the case of a sudden change, the bias current value of the power section becomes unstable, which affects the reproduction of a low-level signal in particular.The M-506RS has a 3-point sensing bias circuit at the output stage, detects the temperature difference between the three points of the pre-driver stage, driver section and power transistor, and controls the bias to achieve stable low distortion rate drive at all times.The protection circuit uses a monolithic IC to increase reliability, and detects DC leakage voltage at the speaker terminals and power stage overcurrent. In the event of an emergency, the relay is instantly shut off to protect circuit components.In addition, a highly reliable gold-plated silver contact relay is used for the speaker switching relay to prevent damping degradation by using parallel connection.In addition, it is equipped with a low-pass filter for LR independent DC voltage detection that works even when the left and right polarities are different."

description: "Stereo power amplifier using super servo system.Onkyo's proprietary Super Servo System eliminates harmful ultra-low frequency components and improves low frequency transient response, which is a problem with DC amplifiers.In addition to the NF circuit, this system consists of a servo loop that combines a low-frequency amplifier and a phase inversion circuit.
