name: INTEGRAA-705DC
description: "Pre-main amplifier with 2 DC configuration that is a DC version of the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier.The equalizer amplifier section is composed of differential amplification and interstage current mirror circuit using low-noise FET at the first stage, front three stage amplification and rear two stage differential amplification including A-class push-pull at the last stage. The high capacitance capacitors in the input side and NF loop are removed, and all capacitors in the circuit are selected from non-inductive film capacitors and high-quality audio capacitors to obtain high characteristics.In addition, the RIAA compensation uses the same NF / CR split circuit as the A-708DC, eliminating intermodulation caused by the slew rate in the high-frequency range. As a result, high-purity sound quality is obtained without sound distortion even in the case of a pulsed signal.The power amplifier uses the same 2-stage cascade drive and 3-stage Darlington connection DC configuration as the A-708DC.For the DC drift of the speaker terminal voltage, which is the most important in DC amplifier, a low-noise monolithic dual FET which has the same characteristics as the first stage differential amplifier is used to construct a stable DC amplifier.The power supply section employs a bus earth system that reduces the potential difference in the ground line across the entire circuit. It also employs a smoothing capacitor with an ESR (equivalent series resistance) of 0.01 � or less that maintains low impedance up to the ultra-high frequency band of 100 kHz. In addition, the power supply fluctuation rate is 0.1% or less and the ripple rejection ratio is 80 dB. From a constant voltage power supply dedicated to the pre-section, the power supply is directly connected to the equalizer and each branch by a multi-spray bus line.This prevents interference within the same channel and between the left and right channels.The tone control amplifier section of both Bass and Treble can be adjusted more finely by switching the turnover frequencies between two stages (with a defeat).As for the circuit configuration, an NF variation type of differential 1-stage operational amplifier configuration is adopted to obtain accurate variation characteristics. In order to stick to the concept of DC & DC, non-inductive film capacitors and low distortion audio capacitors are used for all capacitors.In the unlikely event that a DC voltage appears on the output, the left and right independent detectors electronically detect it and instantly disconnect the speakers to protect them. This circuit also acts as a transient killer to prevent clicks when the power is turned on.For the speaker protection relay, a gold-plated silver contact relay is used as a 2-contact para-type to suppress the deterioration of damping caused by contact resistance. The input selector is directly embedded in the printed circuit board to prevent the deterioration of sound quality caused by the extension of the shield wire.In order to keep the bias current value of the power amplifier stable, a newly developed autotracking bias method is adopted.This is a 3-point sensing bias circuit for the pre-driver, driver and output stage. It prevents bias fluctuations caused by the temperature difference between the driver and the power transistor when switching from continuous large-amplitude operation to pianissimo reproduction, and enables stable low-distortion drive.Equipped with a 2-stage switching low filter that can switch the low cutoff of the power section to DC and 0.1 Hz.At DC, it operates as a DC amplifier without any capacitor in the signal system of the power section and NF. At 0.1 Hz position, it is an AC power amplifier with cutoff of 0.1 Hz and can be connected to other preamplifiers with DC leakage.Equipped with a power amplifier gain 3-stage switching function, the gain can be changed over 3 stages of 0 db, -10dB and -20dB.The s / N ratio for practical use can be improved by lowering the gain of the power section when low volume.The Phono input terminal is gold-plated.The volume is equipped with a low strain rate attenuator with a multi-slider enclosed in a tight die-cast body.Since it is continuously variable and trimless, there is no distortion due to current concentration action, and the interlocking error is within 0.5 dB up to 70 dB."

name: INTEGRAA-708DC
description: "Pre-main amplifier with 2 DC configuration that is a DC version of the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier.The RIAA compensation in the equalizer amplifier section is divided into two types in terms of frequency, high and low. The NF type is used for low boost and the CR type is used for high cut. The CR attenuation is used to compensate for high frequencies, so there is no problem with slew rate or blocking, and intermodulation is reduced.In addition, since these two time-constant circuits handle each band, an excellent accuracy of ¥0.2 dB RIAA deviation between 10 and 100 kHz is achieved.The power amplifier section is DC configuration, low-noise monolithic dual FET is used for the first stage differential amplifier, 2-stage cascade drive system and 3-stage Darlington connection output stage are adopted to obtain good linearity and stable characteristics over the whole range, and the DC drift of the speaker terminal voltage is within ¥20 mv at ¥30 Ï‰ relative to the temperature of 20 ?.Also, switching distortion, which is common in B-class amplifiers, is minimized by driving a power transistor with a high transition frequency fT with a constant voltage drive.The power supply uses a bus-earth (bus line) system that reduces the potential difference in the ground line across the entire circuit.In addition, a smoothing capacitor of E. S. R. (equivalent series resistance) 0.01 � or less that maintains low impedance up to the ultra-high frequency band of 100 kHz, and a constant voltage circuit for the pre-section that is independent of the left and right channels with a voltage fluctuation rate of 0.1% or less and ripple rejection ratio of 80 dB. The D. L. C direct-coupled power supply system that has been cultivated in the past Integra has been adopted. This system prevents mutual interference between the circuits in the front and rear stages of the same channel and between the left and right channels, and also prevents mutual interference between the circuits in the front and rear stages of the same channel and between the left and right channels. It is combined with a DC & DC circuit to improve the rise characteristics of the low-frequency range and secure a sufficient peak power.For tone control, fine frequency adjustment is possible by two step switching of turnover frequency (with defeat).The circuit configuration is a 4-chip configuration (actually 5 chips) using a pair transistor in the first stage. In addition to eliminating the large capacitor of the emitter, a low-distortion film capacitor is also used for the small capacitor (1 Ï‰ F and 10 Ï‰ F) of the NF loop.This makes it possible to control the sound with less degradation even when the tone is turned on.We have further developed the concept of DC & DC, in which high-capacity Chemicon was removed from the NF system of equalizer and power amplifier. We have removed highly strained Chemicon from all signal systems as well as interstage coupling. We have also carefully selected low-distortion non-inductive film capacitors for small-capacity capacitors.As a protective circuit, it is equipped with a speaker relay that detects the DC voltage contained in the output and the overcurrent of the power transistor in a purely electronic manner and disconnects the speaker in the event of an emergency. This relay also functions as a transient killer that prevents a click when the power is turned on. Its operation can be confirmed by an indicator on the front panel.The DC voltage detection section is independent on the left and right sides, so that it can operate even when the DC polarity is different on the left and right sides. The overcurrent detection circuit can quickly disconnect the speaker when the load is short-circuited or when the circuit is overloaded due to a low impedance load.The relay uses a gold-plated silver contact type with low contact resistance.Considering the use of MC cartridge, low noise MC head amplifier of A-class push-pull configuration is mounted.The switches that are important for sound quality, such as input selectors and speaker switches, are embedded directly in the printed circuit board or are switched in close proximity to the terminals to reduce S/N and crosstalk caused by interference from the routing of shield wires, as well as damping caused by an increase in the resistance of the speaker circuit.The power section is a DC amplifier, but the cut-off frequency of the lower range can be changed to DC-0. 1Hz-30Hz with the Cut-off FREQ switch.In the DC position, there is no capacitor in the signal path or NF loop from the input to the output of the power section. The 0.1 Hz position is used as an AC amplifier with a cutoff of 0.1 Hz, and the 30 Hz position is used as a normal subsonic filter.In order to bring out the performance of the cartridge, the load impedance of the MM cartridge can be switched to 3 stages with Phono1.In order to keep the bias current value of the power amplifier stable, a newly developed autotracking bias method is adopted.This is a 3-point sensing bias circuit for the pre-driver, driver and output stage. It prevents bias fluctuations caused by the temperature difference between the driver and the power transistor when switching from continuous large-amplitude operation to pianissimo reproduction, and enables stable low-distortion drive.Equipped with a power amplifier gain 3-stage switching function, the gain can be changed over 3 stages of 0 db, -10dB and -20dB.The s / N ratio for practical use can be improved by lowering the gain of the power section when low volume.The Phono input terminal is gold-plated.The volume is equipped with a low strain rate attenuator with a multi-slider enclosed in a tight die-cast body.Since it is continuously variable and trimless, there is no distortion due to current concentration action, and the interlocking error is within 0.5 dB up to 70 dB."

description: "A pre-main amplifier of the Integra GT series designed with an emphasis on musical performance.The equalizer amplifier section is based on the circuit used in the Integra MKII Series. name: TA-9X
description: "This is a high-grade stereo cassette deck developed by putting all the latest cassette recording technology into the core of Onkyo's original auto-accu-bias system.It uses a closed-loop dual capstan system in which two sets of capstan and pinch rollers are placed on both sides of the head to run the tape.In this system, since the large windows on both the left and right sides of the cassette half are used for drives, it was difficult to use a metal-compatible head with a strong hysteresis loop even in the case of two heads due to space considerations. However, we have solved this problem by developing an ultra-compact double-gap metal erasing head.The S & S Sendust Recording / recording / playback combination head designed for ideal distortion rate and frequency characteristics, with a wide gap for recording and a narrow gap for playback.The core material uses Sendust with excellent magnetic properties and ferrite-like hardness to demonstrate the performance of metal tape.In addition, we have adopted a double-gap ultra-small head that combines a newly developed material Dynaloy and ferrite for the erasing head, and by generating a strong magnetic field by the erasing current from the oscillation block, we have made the erasing function perfect.We have adopted a 3-motor system with exclusive high-torque DC motors for capstan drive, reel drive, and head base drive.The capstan drive motor uses a brushless FG servo DC motor that has received a top-class reputation for its quiet rotational performance and stable swing. Combined with the dual capstan system, this motor realizes excellent wow flutter.In addition, we have improved driving performance and maneuverability through a full-logic silent mechanism that centrally controls the operation of the drive train with a computer.Aiming for top quality during recording, we have developed and installed an auto-accurate bias system that best tunes the bias value for each tape to be used and obtains flat frequency characteristics.When the start button is pressed in the recording pose, the mixed output of two oscillators with low frequency of 400 Hz and high frequency of 10 kHz is recorded while the bias value is continuously changed. The mixed output is then compared and searched between the low and high frequency levels while simultaneously playing it with three heads. The bias value is locked at the point where the levels match. At the same time, the tape is rewound to the start position and waits in the recording pose.Bias tuning is usually completed in a short time of 5 seconds or less (maximum 15 seconds). Moreover, the best bias value is mechanically memorized when the Accu-bias control knob is operated after the auto-Accu-bias operation is completed and the Accu-bias indicator changes from green to red. Therefore, it is possible to take advantage of the auto-Accu-bias even in the case of unattended recording.Equipped with a real-time counter that displays the remaining time and elapsed time of the tape directly in minutes and seconds by switching the switch.A dual sensor system that detects the rotational speed not only from the delivery reel but also from the take-up reel and calculates the remaining time using a computer based on both rotational speeds. This system prevents in principle the effect of tape thickness depending on brand and grade and improves time detection accuracy.In addition, since the remaining time is displayed within a few seconds from any position during a performance, it is also effective when recording is started with a tape in the middle of rewinding. In addition, the remaining time display continues during fast-forward and rewinding in the same way as when playing.There are three types of remaining charge display switches, C-46/C-60/C-90. By simultaneously pressing any two of them, you can also use C-50 (46 and 60), C-80 (60 and 90), and C-120 (46 and 90) tapes.Equipped with Dolby C NR, the noise reduction operation start frequency is lower than that of Dolby B, and high reduction effect in the frequency band where noise reduction is required is obtained.In addition, by adopting a sliding band method in which the operation start frequency is changed according to the magnitude of the input level, the bleeding phenomenon (noise breathing phenomenon), which becomes more conspicuous as the noise improvement amount increases, is solved.In addition, it has a built-in anti-sound saturation circuit that detects over-level in the high-frequency range and suppresses the high-frequency range of the large input signal for recording. By restoring it during playback, the high-frequency saturation level is substantially improved.The built-in recording calibrator enables level correction even if the recording level is different from that of the reference tape.The Auto-Space / Rec Mute function is equipped. When you press the Auto-Space switch during recording, an unrecorded portion is automatically created for approximately five seconds and waits for recording with Rec-Pause.Equipped with digital level indicator using 2-color FL tube.It is a wide range type of -20dB to + 8 db with 7-point peak hold (approx. 3 seconds) that can read the peak value at the moment.Equipped with a timer standby mechanism.0 : 00 position, memory stop and play after rewind is possible."

name: PX-8F
description: "A full auto player with a straight arm.The tone arm is lighter in weight to improve the followability of the arm itself, and by skillfully setting the resonance point of the arm, adverse effects such as warping of records are eliminated as much as possible.In the PX-8F, by adopting a straight arm, the effective equivalent mass is reduced to 15g, which is about half of the conventional S-type arm.In addition, Pyrofil Carbon Fiber is used as the material. This has the advantages of being free from rust and distortion over time, and having a shielding effect because it is conductive.For the tone arm support part, ultra-precision finished miniature bearings subjected to high heat hardening are used, and the feather support system which is very light in both vertical direction and shaft rotation direction is adopted, and the initial motion sensitivity shows an excellent value of 6.8 mg in center value.In addition, an ADC-type connector is used for the shell attachment / detachment part. It detects the large swing of the arm in the eccentric groove at the end of the record, and instantly performs functional processing of the change in the amount of light to identify the difference from the sound groove trace. This prevents accidents such as inadvertent return of the arm during performance.Uses a 20-pole, 30-slot quartz lock system high-torque DD motor.A frequency generator (FG) attached to the motor shaft detects the number of revolutions, and the detected signal is compared with an accurate reference signal obtained by dividing the frequency from a 5.52960 MHz crystal oscillator to compensate for slight disturbances in the rotation.In addition, the frequency generator employs an all-round integration type to cancel even a slight manufacturing error on the circumference, and constitutes a highly stable quartz PLL circuit.The turntable is a large turntable with a weight of 2.2 kg and a diameter of 33 cm. This is a double insulation structure.The insulator consists of a spiral coil spring that is particularly effective in low frequencies and a special shape rubber vibration isolator that is highly effective in middle and high frequencies. The resonance frequency formed by the total weight of the player and the compliance of the coil spring is approximately 10 Hz, and excellent vibration damping effect is obtained in the audible frequency band above this."

name: PX-100M
description: "A high-grade linear motor system with drastically improved rotational bare characteristics, aiming at the ideal phono motor.The PX-100M uses an induction type linear motor that drives the turntable directly around its outer circumference. This motor realizes excellent rotational accuracy. In addition, from the principle of operation as an induction type motor, the rotor has no magnetic pole, and there is no cocking phenomenon associated with the pushing and pulling of the magnetic pole in the movement of the rotor, and ideal smooth rotational characteristics are ensured by the continuous thrust given from the stator.The PX-100M has excellent bare characteristics and does not require a servo circuit. However, since the PX-100M has some slight variable elements such as temperature characteristics of lubricating oil between shaft and bearing, the minimum necessary servo is applied.The principle of linear motor rotation is that when a current is applied to a coil, a magnetic field is generated, and eddy currents are generated in the conductor in the magnetic field. When this magnetic field is moved in the rotational direction, the magnetic flux that cuts the overcurrent changes, so the disk is guided in the direction of the magnetic field. To move this magnetic field, a sine wave with a 90 � phase difference is added. In fact, to increase efficiency, many poles with a 90 � phase difference are superimposed. In addition, to increase the torque of the linear motor, the stator and rotor are opposed to each other in the center so that the magnetic flux acts effectively.In the case of the PX-100M, by arranging the stator 4 blocks facing the rotor symmetrically about the shaft center, torque unevenness is completely cancelled, and smooth rotation is realized.The turntable has a dead weight of 10 kg and an inertial mass of 2000 kg Ï‰ cm.2Moreover, it adopts a heavy class turntable made of pure copper machined, and an extremely thick and highly rigid stainless steel shaft with a shaft diameter of 20 mm and length of 94 mm.By molding pure copper, which has good electrical conductivity and is ideal for linear motor rotors, by machining it, it can be made compact because it has a specific gravity of 8.9. By machining it out of pure copper, the turntable and rotor can be finished in one piece because it is machined out of pure copper. Moreover, the accuracy of the rotor sandwiched between coils can be secured. In addition, dead-end material is attached to the back of the turntable to suppress the rumbling of the turntable.In addition, a tungaloy ball with higher hardness than any other metal is used at the lower end of the shaft, and ethylene resin is used for the thrust seat. The space between the shaft and ball is filled with special oil for heavy loads to improve abrasion resistance and S/N.A high-torque DC motor that operates only at start-up and a drive circuit are installed in order to quickly obtain constant speed rotation.In order to obtain high rigidity, the cabinet is subjected to precision processing by milling after forming an integrated aluminum casting.In addition, Al-Zn damping alloy is used as the material of the arm base, which is inserted into the cabinet and tightened.The turntable sheet is made of transparent amorphous polyolefin by center injection molding and has an excellent uniform thickness accuracy. This eliminates unwanted resonance caused by deterioration of the physical properties and adhesion of the turntable surface.Comes with an acrylic dust cover.The arm base for the long arm was sold separately."

In addition, unlike conventional digital filters, the SM 2000 AP employs image-processing technology in the field of computers to solve unnatural music expressions by sharply cutting out frequencies above the playback limit frequency (20 kHz), thereby realizing smooth interpolation.In addition, stable operation is achieved by using the Accu Pulse Quartz, which is a vibration-resistant rod-shaped crystal mounted on a polysorb cushion, as the master clock that serves as the reference for these devices.The power supply section is equipped with a LASER transformer with ultra-low leakage flux independently in digital and analog systems. In addition, seven systems, two analog systems, two D/A D/A conversion systems, one digital system, one mechanical system, and one muting system. The level of the variable terminal can be adjusted with the attached remote control."

description: "Based on the C-1E of the Quest Integra series, this is a CD player the basic operation of the circuit and introduced high-sound quality parts.The D/A converter has been developed and equipped with FPCS (Fine Pulse Conversion System) based on ONKYO custom digital filter SM5843AP.This FPCS configuration uses SM5843AP and two Philips SAA7350 and TDA1547 independently on the left and right. name: C-1VL
description: "A CD player with a clock that boasts the highest oscillation frequency accuracy in its class.The clock circuit uses a crystal oscillator with oscillation frequency deviation on the order of PPM (parts per million).This clock has a specially machined oscillation frequency deviation of ¥1.5 ppm at room temperature. Compared to the ¥50 ppm oscillator commonly used in this class of CD players, this crystal oscillator has one order of magnitude higher accuracy. The adoption of this crystal oscillator enhances the realistic reproduction of sound images and sound fields.The D/A converter is equipped with WM8740, a Wolfson D/A converter, independent of L/R.This DAC has a sampling frequency of up to 192 kHz and a bit depth of 24 bits. It has high S/N of 120 dB (mono) and 117 dB (stereo). In addition, it is designed to suppress digital noise, which adversely affects sound quality, and to reduce sound quality degradation caused by phase shift.VLSC (Vector Linear Shaping Circuitry) is used to eliminate digital noise.The analog signal output from the DAC chip contains a large amount of pulsed digital noise, which is hard to hear because of its high frequency. However, when noise is mixed into a music signal, it makes it difficult to hear the next minute sound information, or noise and noise make a beat and generate a new noise component within the audible band.The VLSC mounted on the C-1VL consists of a comparator, a vector generator, and an integrator. It generates a new analog signal with reference to the output of the DAC. This circuit does not respond to sudden changes such as digital noise, so the analog signal output from the VLSC has a waveform similar to the sound component of the DAC output without any noise component.In order to cope with the effects of vibration on sound, we have introduced a method to control harmful vibration to harmless vibration mode without killing sound by thoroughly investigating the location where harmful vibration occurs mainly in the mechanism.The casing panel is made of carefully selected materials and shapes such as aluminum and thick steel plates. The front panel and volume knob are made of highly rigid aluminum. In addition, the side panel is made of aluminum with ribs to increase the strength in the vertical direction, and the top panel is made of 1.2 mm steel plate to hold the entire casing firmly. Each part is made of different parts so that the material suitable for each part can be selected, and the propagation of vibration at the top and side parts is prevented.In addition, taping is applied to parts of the housing that are susceptible to vibration.The power supply section is equipped with a toroidal transformer with low leakage flux and good regulation.The output terminal uses a machined gold plated pin jack.The legs use a brass machined insulator.Uses a Direct Digital Path that minimizes the negative impact of digital output signals on sound circuits.Equipped with digital output ON/OFF switching function.Wireless remote control is included."

name: INTEGRAC-300X
description: "CD player with optical transmission system.The optical transmission system adopted in the C-300X is a further development of the conventional one. I.) by adopting new methods combining optical and electronic technologies such as optical transmission devices, optoelectronic modules, and in-phase transformers.In this optical transmission system, an optolink module (front transmission element) is used to transmit data signals with relatively high digital frequencies of 176.4 kHz to 4.3218 MHz that fluctuate. Tracking, focus, offset, and gain related to the accuracy of reading are automatically controlled to optimize values to reduce reading errors.The mechanism that drives the 3-beam laser pickup is equipped with an original linear motor mechanism in order to realize high speed access and high tracking.Rubber magnets have been newly adopted to improve the vibration control of magnetic circuits, which had been difficult in the past. The tray is made of die-cast aluminum and ???? coated to improve vibration control.Furthermore, in order to effectively cut off electromagnetic noise generated by the pickup, the entire mechanism is strictly shielded by a steel case.The power supply is equipped with the double-core laser transformer used in the pre-main amplifier of the Integra series to reduce harmful magnetic leakage. The smoothing capacitor for audio circuits is equipped with a 10,000 Ï‰ Fx2 blue capacitor.In addition, the constant voltage circuit is composed of two stages for the analog type and three stages for the DAC type to improve the stability of the power supply.Two analog output terminals are mounted, and a machined pin jack is used for the fixed output terminal.In addition, it is equipped with two digital outputs that can be turned ON/OFF with the front switch.Equipped with a 4-mode display switching function that enables display ON/OFF.It is equipped with functions such as time edit function, 20-track memory selection, 20-track random calendar, and repeat all songs / repeat between A and B.Uses an insulator made by DuPont Corian.Wireless remote control is included."

name: INTEGRAC-901XD
description: "A CD player with an 18-bit super-real optical converter and optical transmission system.It is equipped with an 18-bit optical converter that uses electrical energy generated by light energy as the constant current source of the D/A converter, which is the source of music signals. In addition, it is equipped with dual optical converters that support the left and right D/A converters, each with its own constant current source.In the optical converter, the constant current source is separated from the power supply of other digital and analog circuits, so that high purity transmission without interference from external noise is possible.The D/A converter is equipped with an independent 18-bit super-real D/A converter for the left and right.The ladder type 18-bit D/A converter has sufficient quality even when used without adjustment. Normally, only the heaviest bit (1 bit) is adjusted. However, the C-901XD is adjusted by 4 bits each on the right and left sides to realize more accurate D/A conversion.An optolink module and a photocoupler, which connect optical transmission and receiving elements with optical fibers, are selected according to the transmission speed. By transmitting light through all six signal paths, the loop is electrically disconnected and digital noise is eliminated.The digital filter uses an 8 x oversampling digital filter to shift the sampling frequency from 44.1 frequency from kHz to 352.8 kHz, 8 times the sampling frequency, and reduces the cutoff characteristics of the low-pass filter, which can cause sound quality degradation.In addition, this 8 x oversampling digital filter outputs 8 times as much data as the original audio signal, so you can enjoy the quality of the original sound that does not pass through the low-pass filter from the output of DAC direct (immediately after D/A conversion).In order to suppress the effects of acoustic feedback and vibration from the floor, we have developed a box structure (double chassis) that is fully tightened to the front, back, left and right sides to increase rigidity. In addition, we have adopted a double chassis as a base, which absorbs vibration propagated from the bottom plate and chassis by two special damping materials sandwiched inside the box structure.The main body of the mechanism is a highly rigid chassis with a resonance dispersion structure that combines a 1.6 mm chassis with an outsert compound molded product. In addition, the sub-chassis mounted on the pickup has the same structure as the main body. It is separated from the main body chassis, and vibration control in both vertical and horizontal modes is performed by special spring and silicon rubber.In addition, the chassis of the mechanical body is attached to a high-rigidity double chassis separated by a non-resilient rubber and a double isolated system is adopted, which reduces internal vibration and speaker vibration.The pickup is driven by a newly developed linear slide motor mechanism with less vibration.To prevent magnetic flux from the power supply, a separator is installed between the power supply block and the electronic circuit block. The top cover is also a two piece structure to completely separate the two blocks. A separator is also installed between the digital circuit block and the analog circuit block to reduce digital noise.The power supply section has a two transformer configuration with a transformer for digital and analog only. The audio transformer has a capacity margin of 300%.It is equipped with two digital outputs, coaxial and optical, and analog outputs of fixed, variable and direct Route 3.In particular, the analog direct connector allows direct output from the D/A converter without passing through an analog low-pass filter.Equipped with a random double calendar.It is equipped with gold plated headphone terminal and output level volume.Wireless remote control is included."

name: INTEGRAC-901FX
description: "The CD player is equipped with an Accupulse D/A converter which combines an Accupulse quartz system and a single-bit D/A converter for the D/A converter.In order to obtain an accurate signal cycle of digital signals, it is equipped with an accupulse quartz system with improved crystal oscillator and oscillation circuit. In addition to adopting a small crystal with a shape that is not easily affected by external vibration, the element is protected by an anti-vibration material (Paris Solar Bar) to suppress external vibration. In addition, the oscillation circuit is equipped with a resonance circuit consisting of a capacitor and a coil, and has an electric flywheel effect to absorb instantaneous fluctuations.It is also equipped with a 0 shift noise shaper that disperses quantization noise frequency characteristics to 0 points to reduce high-frequency noise in the audio band. This ensures 16-bit accuracy in the entire audio band while maintaining 20-bit accuracy up to 12 kHz, which is important for audibility.In addition, during the conversion process from digital to analog, it passes through a PWM (pulse width modulation) circuit. Two PWM converters are installed to solve problems such as high-level signals and distortion at high frequencies.These two PWM circuits are operated in complimentary service, and the output of each is input to a distortion canceler circuit to cancel out the distortion components and output only the audio signal.By applying these technologies to a single-bit D/A converter, we have eliminated the 0 cross distortion and non-linear distortion that conventional multi-bit D/A converters have.The disc tray uses high-rigidity aluminum die-cast to eliminate unwanted resonance during disc playing.In addition, by laying out in the center part where vibration is least transmitted, transmission of harmful resonance modes is suppressed and vibration is not transmitted to electronic circuits.In addition, a high-speed access linear motor is adopted for the drive system to realize quick operation.The mechanism computer simulation, the mechanism is located at the center where vibration is minimal, separated from the chassis. In addition, a super isolated floating suspension with special spring and silicon rubber for vibration control in both vertical and horizontal modes is adopted to eliminate the influence of disturbance vibration.The power supply section is equipped with two LASER transformers unique to Onkyo that reduce the magnetic leakage flux to approximately 1 / 30 of that of conventional transformers, thereby reducing the leakage flux that generates harmful noise due to magnetic induction in electronic circuits.Using an optical transmission method, CD data is optically transmitted and the electrical loop is cut off prevent digital noise from entering the analog circuit.Wireless remote control is included."

name: INTEGRAC-2001
description: "A CD player developed with the aim of the extreme dynamism of compact disc.The D/A converter uses a light-driven D/A converter. This reduces the noise of parts and reduces the influence of external electromagnetic wave noise.The D/A converter uses a real 18-bit system to increase the dynamic range and linearity of the D/A converter while improving the precision by the optical drive. This allows the D/A converter to recover low-order bits that have been lost due to masking caused by semiconductor noise and other factors, thereby achieving an excellent dynamic range and signal-to-noise ratio.In addition, the phase difference is suppressed by the left and right independent configuration.The digital filter uses an 18-bit 4-times oversampling digital filter, and the analog filter uses an operational amplifier discrete 5th order GIC analog filter.An optical transmission method using five optical fibers is adopted for transmission between digital and analog blocks. description: "A CD player developed using the know-how accumulated through the Integra series of amplifiers.Uses a super turbo system that cuts off the power transformer purely electrically.This system uses two circuits, a delta turbo circuit and a turbo filter circuit, to solve the problem of harmful modulation noise caused by the transformer, and suppresses the modulation noise generated by flux generated from the transformer and harmonic spectrum generated by pulse wave for Chemi-Con charging.An 11th-order low-pass filter is used to prevent beat interference (aliasing noise) that occurs between the harmonics of the audio frequency and the sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz.In addition, it employs a super servo circuit that cuts out unnecessary DC components (ultra-low frequencies) that cause intermodulation distortion. name: DT-9000
description: "DAT deck using linear single bit system.In order to review the basics of AD/DA conversion and to solve various problems, a linear single-bit AD/DA converter has been adopted.In single-bit DA conversion, there is no error in the amplitude direction in principle, no distortion caused by the operation shift of the bit switch, and there is no glitch because the time axis error is controlled with high precision by Onkyo crystal oscillation circuit technology.In addition, a single-bit type AD converter is adopted, and the waveform transmission is made faithful by 64 times oversampling, third order noise shaving, two stage digital filter, and low-order low-pass filter (third order), and the generation of unnecessary components such as 0 cross distortion and differential non-linear distortion caused by conventional AD converters is suppressed.The PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) circuit used in the digital-to-analog conversion process has two PWM converters to solve problems such as deep modulation due to strong signals and distortion when the modulation frequency becomes high.These two PWM circuits are operated in complimentary service, and each output is input to a distortion canceler circuit to cancel out the distortion components and output only the audio signal.A high-precision integrated aluminum die cast is adopted for the chassis that supports the mechanism, and the inclined post on the tape winding side is fixed to this chassis in order to further improve the tape travel accuracy.A direct drive system is adopted for the head cylinder and capstan drive. The cylinder motor is equipped with a high-torque magnet with / without spring yoke.
